column1: # English for the MP mod's Russian text (deobf/MP_ENGLISH_SPEC.md): id<TAB>English, id = sha1(trimmed Russian cell)[:10].

column2: Most likely our world became his home over all the years he lived here. So what do we do now?
I humbly and obediently accept this reward.
Next is Novice Chestnut. He's no good with a blade, but you'd hardly find a more accurate archer in the whole kingdom.
Well, then I'll join you too, to help with this difficult task!

Once I was young and green too, just like you. And back in those days, like a fool, I landed in a prison famous all over Varsilia for its harshness. And there the old-timers meet me and offer me a choice: a shiv in the eye, or once up a certain place...
No! She may know where we are and help us get out of here.
[BLUE](A young-looking wizard)[] Oh, hi. You're without Neville. I hope he's all right?
([BLUE]A knight in unusual armour fighting goblins[]) Hit them, buddy!

[BLUE](the man looked at her for a long time, then sighed heavily)[] All right, as you wish, Havis. Send a message to Magister Kaledor. Havis or I would be recognised at once in Istril and reported to Bernadette, so you'll have to collect the cloaks from him. If you have trouble finding him, go to Titus, the captain of the guard; he'll help.
What's the matter?
Hey, who are you?!
What nonsense! How can you kill someone who is already dead?!
Strange that nobody knows about any temple in those mountains or the sorcerers living there.
I need a little time. This isn't magicking off a wart!
Well, all charges against you and your friends will be dropped. You've done excellent work for me...
I helped Hermes reach the settlement, but he turned out to be an impostor! Captain Bloodsilver still hopes I'll rescue the real Hermes.
I found one of the warrior-priest's surviving comrades; I must help him fight off the attacking undead.
Well, I was warned you'd try to fill my head with your inventions.
Thanks, it'll come in handy.
Hi, Mika, I'm glad to see you too. How are you?
Oh, right! I forgot exactly where I am! So, how can I thank my saviour?
Enchant this Bluesteel Shortsword.
Break through!
This is the lever for the mountain lift, which can take you up or down the heights, but it seems someone has jammed it on purpose, and it doesn't work.
An whoo'r you? Don' geddit?! You lookin' fer trouble?!
All right, take me to this Astutus.

Well, excuse me, but today is a day off in hell! Those big guys work around the clock as it is, running through all the worlds answering every call. They need a rest sometime, and I volunteered to fill in!
All right, let's do it.
The best? Are you serious? You just rattle off some nonsense fast while your buddy monotonously beats a drum.

The job isn't very pleasant, and we won't mention it more than necessary, not to each other, and certainly not to outsiders. More than a month ago I made a deal with some lads about deliveries of iron ore. But those lads turned out to be not very good, and because of them I've had some problems with our queen.
The baron?
[BLUE](the woman examined the message you handed her)[] Hm, this is meant for Alarion rather than me. [BLUE](she called one of the guards)[]
I have a minor mana potion, let's keep it simple.
The entrance to the ancient tower Damian told you about.
There was one little detail in that family: my stepfather liked to abuse little boys and girls. Mostly boys. And it went on until one day I found my little brother hanging from a noose in our shed...
I got the snow flowers; now I need to deliver them to Neville in Freetown.
If your head is that big, your brain must be huge too, which means you're very clever?
All right, we'll set off as soon as you're ready.
That damned alchemist has vanished somewhere. We need to find him!
I just wasn't ready for a fight then; I thought you'd manage on your own. And anyway, there's no need to bring it up. What is this hero doing here?
Boss, those bitches never meant to talk. They jumped us the moment we showed up! We had to put them all down!
Yes, thanks for showing me the way!
Dangerous Curiosity
Right, so we'll have to explore this place to work out how to get out. Um, Evelina, why are you without clothes again?
How much will the reforging cost?
And if the guards arrest you, remember: a step to the left and a step to the right is two steps.
I keep getting beaten up badly! Give me more healing potions!

Right, this holy woman can go for a walk and pick some flowers for now, and you'll prove to me how much of a man you are. And don't worry, there's no disease in the world yet that could survive in my body.
Yes, my lady!
Looks like now you're threatening me. Well, you leave me no choice.

Well, one group has settled in Solliga. It's led by a certain mage, Lexus the Defender. The second group was once in Solliga too, but after the feud between them started, they moved here, to Icemist. Their leader calls himself Magister Astutus. I only deal with Astutus's group, since he strikes people off his trust list for any ties with the other group.
[BLUE](The key unlocks the lock without trouble, opening the magic door)[]
Coordinates that will let us find and neutralise the leader of the assassins who are hunting you.
Let's fight them!
[BLUE](Use the magic eggs to activate the spell that destroys the seal)[]
Of course, why not? Maybe I'll find a new partner to hunt with there?
That's where you guessed wrong about who's going to feed the fish.
Maurice agreed to join the crew if I rescue Catherine, a merchant's daughter kidnapped by pirates; Captain Dors can take me there.
Is that all, or is there something else you wanted to share with me?
All right, then let's not waste time. Let's be on our way.
All right, we'll take you home, Cat.
I met the dragon Shenron; he wants me to help him get the Dragonlord's Circlet. I must meet his helpers at the tower in Thyr Pass.

Hm, all right, at least Alarion is a little sincere with one of his people. But still, I'd call Prince Elion, the son of the king's firstborn, the main heir to the throne, though the lad is still young and in poor health. Well, Havis, we agreed to speak plainly, so let's get straight to the point. Does Alarion need my fleet? Considering that Istril's fleet suffered badly during the Heavenly Knights' raids, my ships would be very useful to the prince.

And send a message to Magister Kaledor. Havis or I would be recognised at once in Istril and reported to Bernadette, so you'll have to collect the cloaks from him. If you have trouble finding him, go to Titus, the captain of the guard; he'll help.
An interesting specimen. I'll pay you 135 coins for it. Got any more?

[BLUE](A broken cart lies by the road. Next to it stand Dominic the coachman, whom you know, and another man. At their feet lies someone's motionless body)[] These bastards killed Jes, I won't let this go!
Yes, I decided to join you and help in case serious trouble came up here. Well, who's your employer? Talk, if you want to live.
It looks like he's in serious trouble! But I'm afraid the threat of the witch queen is far worse; we have to deal with her first.

Hm, maybe so. [BLUE](The girl lowers her leg and looks at you intently)[] It was frightening, but exciting too, when those wild men ripped and tore the clothes off me and pawed my body everywhere with their big hands. [BLUE](Evelina's hand slides down between her thighs)[] And there I was, naked and defenceless, surrounded by a crowd of furious savages who wanted me...
Count me out. I have no wish to sail who knows where, and if anyone objects, I'll fry them with lightning!
[BLUE](From the third, big box you take out a beautifully decorated shield with a note: keep being a hero and saving the world, I'm always ready to help you!)[]
I need to know where to start looking. Roughly where was your courier attacked?

Yes, it is. Though the relic has returned to us, that's small comfort next to the loss of all those brave and righteous people in that cursed burial mound. Thank you for the hard labours you had to endure helping us. Accept this ring from me as a reward.
I have a mana potion, let's keep it simple.
Naturally, only find me the right tools, because I don't have any with me.
Let's not drag this out.
And what makes you think I'll reveal his name to you?
And can you come up with anything better?
I hope we're lucky and find the entrance to this temple of knowledge!

Right, we'll head there. But first we need to find some clothes for Evelina. [BLUE](searching the village houses, you found someone's cloak and handed it to the girl, who deigned to get up from her bed)[]
What a gorgeous lake! I wouldn't mind a naked swim in it. Those holy men won't peek at me, will they?
Thank you, I'll keep your advice in mind. See you, Magister.
Now life will be easier for the people of the settlement, rid of this problem!..
That's all great, but I can't sing or play any instrument.
But anyway, if any of them start trouble, Mighty Rock's presence will cool their ardour and any thoughts of violence.
No problem, the old man won't wriggle out of it, I know him well. And don't worry about my safety; sailor Bo and I are great friends, so I'll get to the city by water without any trouble.
[BLUE](The strange creature turns into a pillar of snow, which the wind at once scatters through the forest. Without delay, before anyone else shows up, you cut down the fir)[]
Hey, Gwen, are you home?
Yes. Who is my target, and where will I find him?
Can I receive a blessing?
[BLUE](the door is open)[]
I got a dragon heart; I need to give it to Magister Mundric.
So, any progress?
The entrance to an ancient, dilapidated fortress.
[BLUE](The spell destroys the seal, but it also frees the spirit of the seal's creator, who flies into a rage at what you have done)[]

Thank you. I'm still pondering ways to improve our knights' armour, and I've heard rumours of underground creatures with strong chitin shells living in abandoned mines. Could you bring three such shells?
Well, I wasn't hiding. I thought you were dead, but that doesn't matter, because I can beat the crap out of you a second time!
The poet I must eliminate is called Dustin White; I can find him on the outskirts of New Garand at night.
[BLUE](You peer in that direction, but out of the corner of your eye you notice movement to your right, and you manage to jump aside)[]
([BLUE]A young man in magical attire[]) Hello, glad to see you in our city, but I have no time to talk right now.
Oh, you naughty thing, run quickly before my husband turns up with the guards and has your head cut off!
[BLUE](A very strange-looking dog with green fur)[] So, did you sort things out with the bridge?
Unfortunately, outsiders are forbidden to visit the king's castle.
Come on! Look how cute she is, not dangerous at all!

That's where you're wrong. He doesn't give a damn about seeing your face again or hearing your whining. He wants his money back, so we're here and we won't leave until you hand over everything you owe Umrak, down to the last coin.
I must meet Alarion at night at the old royal castle in the north of the Royal Forest.
Great, I have that armour with me: Ashen Leggings.
Think they'll be more lenient with a girl?
[BLUE](Taste the mushrooms)[]
Wait, I spent a lot of effort and time finding this armour, and now it's mine!
Well, you asked for it, bitch! [BLUE](The bandit has a small club with metal studs)[]
Insert the card the Oracle gave you.
But she wanted you to join her music troupe.
I'll find something suitable and come back.

I must thank you too for saving me from the monster. I'd hardly have reacted in time, it jumped out at me so fast! I thought its claws were already sinking into my flesh! Once again I'm convinced adventures like this aren't for me!
Exactly. You're the ones who should clear off nicely.
[BLUE](A respectable-looking man who doesn't much resemble a bandit)[] Kiara is the boss here, but most money matters are handled by me.
You know, since you helped me, maybe you're ready to help once more? You won't be sorry, with personal gratitude and more!

I don't know. Perhaps she wants to use his life to blackmail the governor of Sol-Laqueul, or me. She doesn't need extra unrest, but thanks to you her plan fell through, and the prisoner can serve to neutralise things.
So that Makbul of the Seventh House will trust me, I need to collect an agreed item for him from a man named Omar.
And what happened? Why are you here alone, serving the Lady?
You'll become material for the undead yourself, or you'll give me your stone!
There are some tunnels here. They'll lead us somewhere. Maybe even to the Temple of Knowledge we're looking for.
Not much. They feed on blood and live on Mount Storme.

Oh, at last someone besides me who hasn't turned into a monster! Want to know what happened here? It all started a few days ago. Our kingdom was waging a long war with its neighbours and losing, and to turn things around, some of the nobles decided to perform an ancient ritual in the temple to summon a messiah.

He is in the great hall, but a magic field blocks the way there. I've studied it, and as I understand it, it's sustained by totems, most likely three of them. If we find and destroy these totems, the protective field will weaken, and I'll be able to remove it.
I must meet the Archon and the pirates west of the Dragon's Nest at the river mouth, but try to avoid taking part in the attack on the governor's son.

Well, first of all, at least about the fact that I have nothing to do with necromancy. I'm an ordinary mage who learned what no one outside a narrow circle was supposed to know, and now they want to shut me up and, along the way, make me the scapegoat for the outrage going on in the sewers.
Shut up, idiot! 3000 coins and you can clear off.
Go around it.
The unknown knight received his family sword and left the villagers in peace.
I was attacked by a wizard hired by the same unknown person again; I need to find someone who can really help solve this problem.
This will take a couple of hours!
What is this settlement?
[BLUE](You peer in that direction, but out of the corner of your eye you notice movement to your right. You don't react in time and take a blow to the head)[]
Can you bless this Terrifying Sword?
Excellent! The teacher has gone to the old tower in the Southern Bluemist River, and he warned me that if you showed up we should go to him. So let's be off!
I've come to talk about the hunter Mironn.
The go-between said the blackmailer is in Solliga; we need to go there and find him.
You interfered in my organisation's affairs, and I had to answer your insolent stunt.
Here are the fox tails you asked for.
Yes, understood.
All right, I'll bring you something tasty.
Hey, actually I wash every day! There are wonderful hot springs in a cave under the castle here!
All right, I won't bother you any more.
A One-Way Road
You have to be the best at everything. A woman carries a child for 9 months. I carry one out in a single punch.
But you came back to us anyway! All right, let's not linger, come on.
In the Sagar Forest I met a forester who offered to share his mushrooms with me, and I agreed.
If you're ready, we're off to the showdown.
[BLUE](A scruffy-looking bandit roughly harassing a girl)[] Well, done running, bitch? Now hand over the money!
[BLUE](A second young lad, looking just as sugary)[] Oh, come on, they won't go anywhere in New Anthur. They'll wait for us as long as it takes.
Uh, Kiara, that wasn't serious! We were just kids back then, making up all kinds of nonsense!
Bless this Silver Longsword.

Hey, calm down. You have no proof the Lady's people were involved in this attempt, do you? Am I right? Just guesses based on the existing feud? Before our relations are ruined for good, this incident needs investigating, and the negotiations continued at the same time. To start with, I propose a personal meeting between the Lady and your boss on neutral ground.
Fine, walk however you like. Actually, I came here looking for Bridge's friends.
This sword will be even deadlier than it already was!
And what are you going to do about it?
What a meeting. Didn't expect to see me again? Well, I'm not that easy to kill!

Actually, I don't need it anymore. I talked to Jumbo, and we decided our... friendship matters more than some stupid bets. Anyway, we don't care who has the bigger one. Happiness isn't in your dick, right?
Gigi brought me to the leader of the sorcerers' faction, Magister Astutus; I need to get him to help solve Vince's problem, but I'll have to pay him 50 thousand coins.
Don't hit me! I'll serve you, just give me a little {LEVELx10} for grub.
No, we have enough problems here without some zombies.
Nothing, let's move on.
Good, a strong guard must be organised there in case the Varannari attack again. See to it. I'll go to Nivarian and report our victory. If you need more people, I'll send you reinforcements.
What do you take us for, suckers?! Let you go so you vanish for good?! We'll settle everything right here!
All right, see you, Magister.
Damn it, we've been set up! We have to get out of here before anyone else sees us here!
But at least we'll die free of chains!
That's excellent news! At last one problem fewer. And as for my hero's reward, I offer you a choice: 5 thousand coins, or the ancestral blade from my grandmother's side of the family.
You asked for it, goat!
All right, let's go.

[BLUE](following the Archon through a door you hadn't noticed before, you entered the next room, which held a spacious open cage with a dozen scruffy-looking men in it)[] Before you get down to work, so to speak, the princess wants to be sure of your fighting skills, or rather, your ability to kill.
[BLUE](A warlike-looking priest)[] Hello, wanderer. I'm still gathering a team for the holy mission.
Um, Eirenda, you wanted to share some important information that will help us get rid of the evil dwelling on Mount Storme?
Well, they're definitely bigger than I remember from last time... So, what about these sorcerers?
You can go home now, buddy. Thanks for the help, and goodbye.
I won't let you, teacher, simply risk the lives of so many beings. It's not their fault they ended up in a foreign world!
Disorder is bad. Perhaps I'll leave you alone for a while, if you serve the kingdom well.
[BLUE](It seems the Chief Philosopher and his gang have caused a riot in town!)[]
Damned green-skins, you've teamed up to do your shameful deeds together and harm people?!
An unknown creature attacked me; I must deal with it.
Huh? That place is full of your kin, and they won't be happy to see you!
I found the lost boy; I need to return to the Keeper from the lake.

I found out it's a mercenary named Durant who worked for the Friguld governor. He has put together his own gang, and he's working in alliance with some wicked sorceress and another gang led by Jack "the Torero".

How terrible! The village head must be told, but we probably shouldn't cancel the holiday, so as not to upset the boy. I talked to him, and he promised to be more careful with the clothes I give him, so we'll decorate the fir together.
Bandits have kidnapped several girls who work for the mistress; the kidnappers' lair is near Kingsbridge, and I must free them.
Nail and his gang walked into Praetor Anwar's ambush, and I need to survive somehow!
[BLUE](Use the third variant)[]
When they call me that, I feel like an old woman! What little rotters all these kids are!
What? That's as easy as anything. But how you can walk on the ground, that I don't understand?!

Well, actually my target is Balthazar, but since a connection between you two was recently discovered, I decided to keep an eye on you too and then make contact. But first I wanted to assess your abilities and strength personally; you didn't end up in such a very dangerous place for nothing.
Buddy, some jerk is hiding over there spying on us! Hey, we can see you, idiot!
All right, let's figure out what's going on here. I'll go to my stash and try to take one of the attackers alive and question him about who hired them.
No, I'm not interested.
Well, if you have [BLUE]8000 coins[], we can come to an arrangement.
Great! And Alice will help you again!

A wizard from Istril asked me to help him find unique Myrosian armour; I agreed. First I need to collect the fragments of a magic map; for that I must find and explore ancient ruins in the wild places of the Kingdom of Sorrow.
The magister told us of a conspiracy in the Guild, and Sansa has become one of the conspirators' targets; we need to question one of the suspects, named Grateroll, in Icemist.
What stupid selfishness?! This legendary armour must become public property! And you'll get a worthy reward in return!

Hm, your girl is right! I've also seen heaps of different treasures in my life, and next to them this thing looks pretty lousy. Though to be sure it's genuine, we should go to someone I know. He's a very ancient goblin who loves studying all these dragon legends. He'll surely understand it better than we do.

Buddy, we only have one more artifact to find, then we'll get our treasure and be unbelievably rich! I'll go back to Freetown for now, maybe I'll be lucky and learn something about the last artifact. We'll meet there later!
[BLUE](A young-looking sorceress)[] Let's not get distracted by talk.

The lady whose bedroom you accidentally stumbled into while saving her from an intruder; you also agreed to help her with a personal matter. I hope you haven't changed your mind. The lady is ready to meet you, and I can take you to her, but only you, alone.
But this is the Temple of Knowledge. I hoped to find some powerful magical artifact here!
All right, Layla and I will check all the costumes and instruments once more and get them ready for transport.
You should've started with that! Let me go to Umrak right now and sort out this unpleasant situation with him!
What exactly?
These freaks will regret coming here!
All right, let's borrow your father's knife.

[BLUE](at last it seems to have returned to a normal state)[] Thank you for the activation. Part of my data has been lost, but according to my analysis, at least 100 years have passed since the previous start-up.
Oh, don't call me that!
Go inside.
I want to thank you too, miss! I found this thing in those ruins and I want to give it to you!
I spent my childhood in a village like this, although I remember little of those distant days; I was taken to Icemist at a young age as a student of magic.

Oh, don't worry! We don't interest orcs in that way! I managed to study them a little before I ended up here. They belong to a completely different species, different from us not only in appearance but mentally too. We humans are not sexually attractive to orcs, just as, to make a slightly crude comparison, dogs are not attractive to people in that way. There may be exceptions, of course, but they must be rare.
What needs to be done?
And who are these two groups?
Without a doubt, sooner or later punishment will catch up with them, and I will be one of the many who defeat this evil!
And what do you know about this daredevil himself? Maybe we could find him and hear about his journey from him in person.
Not now, thanks. I'd better go.
I have a Whitetower Special!
Thank you, friend, for helping me deal with these creatures! I'm Peter of Rigordion, and I came here with my comrades on a holy mission that we are now not destined to fulfil.
The prick came to me through a go-between, but I managed to get him talking. It's some wizard, Draytroll or Greytpoll or something like that.
Great joke! But seriously, Kiara, what do you say to my friend's offer?
Reforge this war pick.
I'm ready to join your team to rid the people of this terrible threat.
Of course, and now let's get out of here.
Enchant this Elm Wand.
Where? Somewhere around here, and there are three of them in all, got it?
Kalagru.
You're quite the joker, I see.

Well done! Soldiers, search the bodies of these scoundrels and find the stolen goods they tried to carry off. Thank you for your help, traveller. Go back to town. I've ordered my deputy to give you the promised reward.

Alarion is a prince, the son of King Kalion the First, exiled to this backwater a couple of years ago for his foolish antics. What's more, since his elder brother and elder sister died of a blood disease, the king's second son was killed during the first Sky Knight invasion, and their children are still too young, Alarion is the chief heir to the throne. As for his plan, you'll find out later; maybe he'll tell you everything himself.
You'll go to the nearest sewer yourself right now, but you won't need a protective suit, since you'll be dead, unless you give me your stone!
I'm looking for Bridge's friends. Can you tell me where they might be?
[BLUE](A muffled clang echoes through the dungeon, and you see a metal bridge lower over the chasm. Soon all falls silent again)[]

This is my pride! Assembling this device cost me incredible effort, and now, thanks to the substrate you collected and the artifact you returned to me, it will work! [BLUE](After the wizard's incomprehensible manipulations, a strange metal arch begins to glow and hum)[] Yes! At last, after countless years, my wonderful plan is coming true, and the great goal of saving our world will be achieved!
I won the fight; now I need to talk to the arena master about freeing Katasakh.
The door to the sorceress's tower is open.

[BLUE](you notice a blind beggar, the same swindler, Adaon's acquaintance, you've met before)[] Have mercy, spare something for a poor blind man! I'm hungry and wretched... You again! Please go away, don't scare off the locals!
Excellent, support will certainly not hurt.
Sure, why not.
[BLUE](at these words, the still bodies of the townsfolk lying on the cobbles began to move. The dead rose, and an animal growl that boded you no good burst from their throats)[]

In short, my lady collects all kinds of rare flowers, and she's heard of some snow flowers that grow only in the Thyr Ridges, somewhere far to the north on the coast. And I decided to give them to her. There was a rumour a local herbalist had some, but that turned out not to be true, and on top of it the guards caught me.

[BLUE](A nondescript house, outside and in. You find yourself surrounded by nasty-looking men. One of them, his face hidden by a hood, keeping apart from the others, speaks to you)[] Greetings, friend, and welcome to our lair. I'm Rickman, and I'm in charge here.
Enchant this Silver Mace.
And what other dangers will await me in this tower?
Bernadette is our king's youngest daughter. She heads the secret service. Officially they don't exist, so they can commit all sorts of cruelties and bear no responsibility.
I still can't work out where you are. I don't see you in front of me.
Hi, I have to go.
A talking green dog offered to show me the way, but I refused.
The forester I ate mushrooms with has been kidnapped by little green men; I must rescue him and get out of the place I've ended up in.
Hey, I don't care what happened between you! We agreed on a peaceful meeting. And I'll feel safer in your castle with this hero around.
Hello, sweetie. Do you need my potions, or have you brought me something to sell?
Great, I have that armour with me: Leggings Heavenly Knights.
Oh no! Cursed bandits! Don't come near me! I'm a priest, the Three protect me!
Bless this Bluesteel Greatsword.
[BLUE](Ignore)[]
Let's go back to New Garand, where we can celebrate this victory.
[BLUE](With difficulty, the dead man begins to utter some numbers and letters)[] Do you have a sheet of paper? We need to write these coordinates down!

Stop fooling around and denying it. I can see some of the stolen things right over there! [BLUE](You point at a big heap of all sorts of things, among which you spot the fir tree Jeanne and Kai decorated)[]
Guards!!!
I must talk to Neville's lady about performing the ritual to lift the moon curse from her.
Right, we steal from thieves and give the loot to the poor, yes?
I propose a duel. We'll fight on equal terms, one on one. What do you say?

[BLUE](Evelina turns out to be very demanding, and you have enough stamina to satisfy her completely. Though it seemed she would never have enough, your efforts clearly exceed all the girl's expectations)[]
[BLUE](While the mage and his apprentice argue, paying you no attention, activate the artifact Zeref gave you)[]
Good, I'll pay you 100 coins for it. Got any more?

No need to thank me. You hardly learned anything useful from my story. I would be glad to help with your problem, but I know no way to solve it, and I have not heard of one from the other shamans of my people.
The Curse has taken control of High Priest Killian and all his men, so I'll have to fight him!

[BLUE](Having calmed down, the man speaks again)[] I knew Alarion was a fool, of course, but I didn't suppose he was this stupid! He intends to overthrow his father peacefully? What nonsense is in his head?! And for that he needs my vote in the Council!? So I, the governor of once-rebellious Sol-Laqueul, should show up at the royal castle and speak out against the king there? They'll chop my head off at once. Or can the prince guarantee my safety? I rather doubt it. He's in disgrace and forbidden to be in Istril.
What a nosy busybody you are! You've managed to meet my sister and cross paths with my foolish little brother. But I'm not going to waste words on you; you're a dead man anyway.
Ah, my brave hero, you saved a defenceless lady! How can I thank you?

Don't throw false accusations at me, or you'll pay dearly if it happens again! I have no use for your boss's death, for now. Besides, I still don't know where your main lair is. My street girls managed to follow the kidnappers all the way to their hideout. So, your task, my heroic friend, is to free the captives.

Work? Yes, there's something, though I wouldn't call it work. It's more of a holy mission. A terrible demon bear has appeared in our forests, exterminating every living creature without distinction. Now even the most seasoned hunters are afraid to go deep into the thicket, and I fear the creature will soon start leaving the forest and attacking the settlements. So the high priest decided to gather a team of the strongest warriors to put the monster down, and I volunteered to lead this mission.
The northern kingdom? No problem, I'll just have to dress warmer.
Well, uh, I didn't think it mattered. That's not why you took me into the crew.
I'll drown you in a barrel of beer right now and take your stone!
Hey, calm down, no need to get heated, let's discuss everything peacefully!.. [BLUE](But it seems nobody is listening to you anymore)[]
[BLUE](A warlike-looking priest)[] Did you find out anything about the demon bear's lair?

All right, then I won't bother you.
Anyone can throw a stone at a wolf, but not everyone can throw a wolf at a stone.
Damn, looks like you won, but don't hope to get out of here alive. I'll take you with me. I've got a little present for you!
[BLUE](Using brute force to put a collar of submission on him)[]

Well, you can keep quiet, nobody's stopping you, just as nobody's stopping me from taking you to the city, where I know the captain of the guard. He'll readily believe me that you're the one who killed the owner of the house you were watching. There'll even be witnesses who saw you near the place. And I'll also see to it that you get the harshest punishment under the law of Thuram.

But King Kalion was known for his healing skills, and thanks to him the baby survived, but she remained very weak and for five years did not learn to speak. Many teachers assumed she would remain simple-minded, but to their surprise the girl did master speech and very quickly learned to read and count, and took up various sciences. Besides that, she showed a talent for magic, which is no surprise: her mother was a powerful sorceress and a member of the Magic Council.
Then who are you, and what are you doing in this cursed place?
Hmm, this cloak looks familiar. I believe it belongs to Sir Damian, whom I sent on an important errand a couple of days ago. There has been no word from him since.
[BLUE](The little boy has just come over to look at the tree you brought)[] Wow, what a beautiful fir tree! Once it's decorated, it'll be even better!
All right, actually you're not bad-looking at all, even quite attractive in your own way. You just need a bit of washing off the slime, but I'm ready to satisfy you as you are, right here and now!

No need to shout for nothing; I simply offered a higher price for the service. I see you've finished building your device! Excellent! Well, we don't need you any more, but if you behave calmly and stay out of other people's business, I'm willing to let you go in peace.
Great, I have that armour with me: Dragon Armor.
[BLUE](The serving girl is clearly busy with customers)[]

[BLUE](Several possessed have crowded around the girl, one standing a little way off by a brazier, holding a burning branch, but they all break off from what they're doing at your arrival and start growling at you viciously. Evelina raises her head at the noise and notices you. Her eyes open wide, but she makes no sound, since her mouth is gagged with some rag, but she starts twitching and writhing in her bonds)[]
Nothing yet. I wanted to ask: have you come across zombies in your woods that look like clergy?
[BLUE](A peasant by the cart greets you)[] Good day to you! If you don't fancy walking, I can take you in my old wagon.

Right. I'll hire a ship in town so you, Vince, can get to Friguld and find out everything for sure. And you, Johnny, together with our friend, will go to that Ilmaran settlement where the Varannari live and try to get them talking about wild magic.

[BLUE](A kindly-looking old wizard glancing around fussily)[] Greetings, valiant traveller! My name is Balthasar the All-Knowing. Will you spare me a moment? Very strange things have begun happening in our lands. Out of nowhere, all sorts of outsiders never seen before have suddenly started appearing. I'm trying to get to the bottom of it, but I can't do without the help of a brave and mighty hero.
What do you say, little dragon?
Bless this greatsword.
I have no close and loyal allies left; it's all in vain now. If I carry on there will be even more pointless deaths, and it won't lead anywhere.
Greetings, traveller. The Heavenly Knights have landed on the coast. It's not safe here!
We do not share our secrets with the impiri. But you are known among us. What exactly did you want to know?

Well, I recently met a certain she-dragon. An indescribable delight, she's all death and destruction of everything and everyone! Only she thinks I'm a loser: like, my cave under the mountain is small and there aren't enough jewels in it, I burn fewer than the proper hundreds of heroes a year, and most of all, that my, well, you know what, is small! But that's not true, not by dragon standards anyway!
I must assemble a crew for the heist; first I need to recruit the spy Anika Jennet in Nivarian.

Yes, that's exactly the problem. However many of these creatures we kill, there are only more of them, and one of the high priests believes it's all because of a curse dwelling in the burial mound not far from us.
And what are you going to do now?

Well, a jack of all trades named Hermes settled here with us. He made life much easier for the locals with the inventions he created, but a few days ago he suddenly disappeared. My scouts managed to find out that the Heavenly Knights kidnapped him.
If the guards couldn't handle you, I will!
Hello, you don't happen to sell celery or radishes, do you? The choice of vegetables in town has shrunk lately.
Well, it's clearly unwise to turn down a dragon. So what's this job?
Here's your reward: a magic cloak, as I promised.

The messenger who was supposed to bring your reward from the castle has run off. He was seen near the sewers. Unfortunately, all my people are busy with the orcs right now, and I have no one to send after the scoundrel. You can try to catch him yourself, and meanwhile I'll go to the castle and try to get you compensation in case you don't manage to catch the thief.
[BLUE](a bluish smoke began to envelop you, and soon it was so thick that nothing could be seen through it. When it began to clear, you realised you were in some other, unknown place)[].
I have a minor mana potion, go ahead!
All right. And after that, shall we go back to the city or deal with your errand?
This sword will be even mightier than it already was!
Bless this Bluesteel Greataxe.
If everyone is ready, we set out.
I want to thank you too, mister! I found this thing in those ruins and I want to give it to you!
I thought you were dead!
Sorry, but this time we won't part peacefully.
Glad to help, but who are you, and why are you alone here in the middle of the swamps?
Well, you know where to find me if you want to see me again, my friend.
The door leading out of the sorceress's tower.
Makbul's boss needs to get some things out of the city, quite possibly stolen ones; I agreed to help them. I need to meet him at night.
No need, captain. The hero will be in the castle under my responsibility. Let's go.
Dominic has started a showdown with a gang of slavers; I must help him defeat them.
Obviously a magic door, covered in runes, with no keyhole or handles; all it shows is an image resembling a very menacing old man.
Well, you obviously know how to kill. Let's go and discuss our business with the princess.
Thanks for the help, buddy! If not for you, I'd be dead or worse!
Good to see you too.
Thanks even for that. In short, I need information about an ancient troll that has eggs with powerful magic power, and where it lives.
My work on this armour will cost you 260 coins, and I'll also need two white wolf pelts.
Sounds dangerous. I think I'll pass.
No idea, but try asking the customers. Maybe they've heard something.
Great, I have that armour with me: a Forest Jacket.

To begin with you could just try to scare him off our family, but if that doesn't work, then he'll have to be killed after all. Once rid of this swindler, I'll keep a closer eye on who my husband meets. I understand it's not an easy job, but I'm ready to reward you handsomely.
Magister Windchaser turned out to be the very man who hired them! Percy suggested going to Lannegar to catch the leader of the brigands hunting me and use him to set an ambush for the wizard.
Every one of these queers will get what they deserve!
[BLUE](One of the surviving members of Nail's gang)[] Hey, you, damned rat! The Seventh House will learn about your doings here, so don't hope to go unpunished!
This must be the hideout of the adventurer who stole the sword.
What?! You can talk?
Oh no, Kiara! [BLUE](He rushes to the woman lying on the floor while you deal with the archer)[] Don't die, Kiara! Don't die!
I'm so tired... Dear, I'll go to my chambers. We'll see each other later, when I've rested!

Here's what's known about that case. There's an old magister, Mundrick. He's retired and lives quietly on his pension. It was to him that the adventurer who'd been to the temple came, and he even brought some thing back from there, supposedly needed to reach the lower levels of the temple. So if you need details, go to Mundrick. His house is in Whitetower. Maybe you can even buy that thing from the temple off him. He's a cantankerous old man, of course, but I think you can find a way to approach him.
Remember, it doesn't matter how many times you fell. Nobody was counting anyway.

I noticed you were watching a certain house whose owner we meant to visit, and it seems you were waiting for my two friends in particular to arrive, in order to report it to the guards, weren't you? But you clearly sensed something had gone wrong and decided to slip away. A strange way to spend your time, unless you're paid for it. And I'm just curious about the name of the one who hired you.
Agnius suggested hiring three hunters to supply us with pelts; I've found two, one more to go.

Oh, all right, I'd have had to start this conversation with you sooner or later anyway, though I'd rather it had happened under other circumstances... One of my spies told me where you were, so that's why I'm here.
Hm, you know, then I can help you acquire a proper home in Icemist. How does that sound?
You're a mean lady! [BLUE](The little boy bursts into tears)[]
I've brought you the artifact.
I'll tell you when you grow up. Layla, I heard, runs her workshop in Kingsbridge, and Violetta and her friends organise all kinds of little tournaments and carnivals in New Garand.
The man Kiara sent to the meeting turned out to be a traitor; I must deal with him.
Got you now, Lexus! Didn't expect this, did you, villain?!
[BLUE](a middle-aged man, a trinket seller)[] Well, well, look who's come to the capital: Neville in person! What wind brings you here?
And what will you do? Chase me off with your bleating that you call vocals?
Yes, and a very skilled one, believe me, and I have something that I'm sure will interest you a lot.

And it seems I can no longer help Alarion. After what happened to Princess Evelina Lightwind, my days are clearly numbered too. Perhaps I should try to escape from Istril, but I'm afraid Bernadette can find me anywhere. Tell Alarion about this.
Of course! I've already found out where those bastards are. The authorities wanted to try them by their laws, but I don't care about that. I'll be judge and executioner for those animals!
[BLUE](You're caught in a whirl where it's impossible to see anything or even tell up from down. But then it all stops, and you're back in Whitetower)[]
Well, if I help you get it, will you help my friend and me clear ourselves of the false charges?
I need to go to Lamis, where I may find information about Adaon's killers.
The captain of the guard is unlikely to help; I'll have to find whoever sent the thief into my house myself.
So what was your plan, Baron? To set us against each other? But what would you gain from that?
All right, I'll try to do it, Mika.
In case you didn't know, I'm very good in bed, so I'm not getting up more than I have to.
So how is this information useful to us?
I must meet Neville's accomplice at night in Freetown; he'll take me to the young lady I'm to eliminate.
And where's the entrance to this tavern?
Hey, what's that?!
Calm down, Catherine, it's all behind you now! Here, take this for your help. I'll take the girl to her father, and then go straight to Captain Dors to get to New Garand for the meeting with Hugh.
The world around you spins fast, and along with streams of your own vomit you end up in a completely different place.

[BLUE](a sturdy-looking old man with a stern face smiled when he saw you)[] Greetings, traveller, glad you made it. I hope those ice guardians didn't give you any trouble? They're very old, the magic in them has weakened, which makes them hard to control, so sometimes they attack everyone indiscriminately. You're probably wondering what some old man is doing here on an island in the middle of a lake?
We'll help you gain your freedom. Where can we get the artifacts we need?
What lies further north?
According to the latest reports, he has settled in the old lighthouse north-west of the Dragon's Nest.

Oh, I felt Oberon's presence suddenly vanish. [BLUE](The woman takes Oberon's heart, and it instantly freezes in her hands and crumbles into small pieces of ice)[] Well, at least he's free from the chains of an eternal, meaningless life, and his spirit has found peace...
I've fallen into an ambush by unknown mages! I must deal with them.
Thanks, I hope it works out for you.
Maybe we can make a deal?
Something Is Coming...
You'll find me in the temple of Rigordion if you need my help again.
Great, I have that armour with me: Tolassian Chain Leggings.
Yep, me and my friend. Hugh is planning a new job, and we need you, Katasakh.
So far it's all empty talk and nothing more, buddy. I'm ready. Are you going to get down to business, or are you scared of something?
I'll do everything I can.

What?.. It can't be! This is a detector that senses the presence of outsiders... [BLUE](The wizard's gaze slides across the room and stops on his apprentice)[] So that's why you care so much about these outsiders: you're one of them!
I've been ordered the hide of a spotted swamp creature. From what the local hunters told me, these beasts live somewhere in the eastern part of the Tormenting Marshes, far to the north.
So far we're managing against the undead, but there are more and more of them. Don't drag out your errand, or there'll be no one left alive here to reward you!
I need to get into the castle itself to find the surviving villagers.
I came to terms with two groups of fishermen.
But she's your friend. She speaks well of you and hopes for your goodwill. Maybe she's too chatty and loves making up all kinds of nonsense, but that's no reason to be offended and upset her.
Great, I have that armour with me: Legion Leggings.

([BLUE]A knight in unusual armour, cleaning blood off his sword[]) Thanks again for the help, buddy! Now the goblins will certainly cause the settlers less trouble, and I'll keep trying to drive the green vermin away from these lands for good.
All right, where can I find this forester?
All right! [BLUE](To your surprise, the girl bends down, pulls off her panties and holds them out to you)[] Here, I hope you're lucky and manage to catch this stalker!
Depends on the potions.

All right, all right, if you need it that badly: you'd have to go a very long way around the snowy plateau to find a suitable place to climb, but not far off there's a small hill with a cave entrance, and those caves lead up there. But be careful. The caves are full of dangers.
A hundred and forty?! Incredible! How is that possible?
The castle is under siege, the gates are closed. Get out of here!
I found the knight Damian. He supposes the way out of this place is in the magic fortress, but getting into it requires his powers, which something in the cemetery to the north-west is blocking.
[BLUE]A menacing fatso in heavy armour guarding the castle gates[]
Er... Actually, this message isn't from the tax office, but from an anonymous source.
[BLUE](a serious-looking, richly dressed man)[] Greetings. Report to me as soon as you make progress in your work.
Try to break the glass with something heavy.
Maybe it'll still work out for you.
And who are these light people?
To get the royal permit I must eliminate some poet; I need to meet the client's man at night in New Garand.

What an unusual weapon! To lay the charms effectively I'll need other ingredients, namely fourteen human skulls and two demonic ones. And because the work is difficult it'll cost more: [BLUE](1600 coins)[].
Accept these gifts in thanks for saving our lives!
Great, I have that armour with me: a Tempered Breastplate.
Yes, let's go on. And, oh, I hope you won't tell anyone how I had an accident here?
Will I have to kill them?
Oh, then we can help you so you don't lose time. What needs doing?
Hi, hero. I'm busy right now. I have no time to talk.
The cursed blood didn't grant me immortality, but it let my spirit remain in my body. But no matter. Wherever you've hidden my wife, I'll find her, and the ritual will be completed!

You won't believe it, but I'm the leader and lead vocalist of the famous and very very best music troupe in all of Varsilia! I named it [BLUE]"Lilac Blackberry in Trembling Clouds"[]! Doesn't that sound so cool?! Any day now I'm going to set up a tour. We'll travel all the towns and villages of the kingdom and play to packed houses!
[BLUE](you notice a blind beggar, the same swindler, Adaon's acquaintance, you've met before)[] Have mercy, spare something for a poor blind man! I'm hungry and wretched...
[BLUE](a woman in a hooded cloak)[] Let's head for the exit, there's nothing more for us here.
The magic map is restored; now I must use it to find a cache in one of the ruins where I searched for the map fragments.

Don't count on it, idiot. I guessed right away you'd try something stupid here, so I came prepared. And it's good you came in person. I'll get the chance to finish you with my own hands, unless, of course, you lose your nerve at the last moment and try to run, but I've cut off your escape routes!
The wizard Isabot suggested the crystal is somehow connected to the red ghost that has begun appearing at night around Freeport; I need to find it.

That's for sure! Recently we met a sorceress who makes magic spheres that can store how we perform songs, and thanks to these spheres our songs can be heard anywhere and anytime without us! Soon we'll start selling these things, and the sorceress is thinking about how to make it so these spheres don't just let you hear our songs, but see us singing in them too!
Maybe he's hiding somewhere?
If he really did betray me, don't stand on ceremony with him, but first try to make him talk about the other rats.
That's none of your business, got it?
I want to speedrun this game fast, help me with that!
No idea who that was, but I'm glad it passed without a battle!
Excellent, then let's get to work.
You know The Undermother? I'm the father.
Never mind. You'd better tell me quickly why you were following me, while you're still in one piece.
The boss is expecting you, and don't even think of leaving town early. We'll find you again anyway!
Reforge this greataxe.
Magister Windchaser's ritual didn't go to plan and he died; now I need to deal with the consequences of his failure.
What a nightmarish holiday!? I hope they don't hold it in this settlement?

Yes, I heard something about it back in my student days, but I can't recall anything really useful. Although there was a lad back then who was very keen on the subject, and I think he's now a great expert on it.
Glad you've accepted me. Perhaps you'd find information about the location of the laboratory Astutus recently set up useful.
Hey, are you alive? I have healing potions, I can help you!

[BLUE](This warrior cleric looks saner than the others and has no intention of attacking you)[] Your deed, stranger, is without doubt a noble one, but you shouldn't have come so far. No one can be saved here now.
I need to talk to Rickman about being ready to take part in the showdown.
[BLUE](Another bandit comes running from somewhere, the same one you met by the road threatening a girl)[] Hey, Vince, get back to the base right away!
Hermes died on the way back to the settlement; I need to tell Captain Bloodsilver.
Thank you for helping me escape and reach this settlement. I won't bother you any more.
Enchant the sword Orcslicer.
Oh, the poor thing, what a pity. I asked her not to follow me, but she never listened to what I said. It can't be undone now, but we can still find the villainous wizard who caused it and punish him.

I'm an arcane knight in exile. I can't tell a stranger more about myself. As a noble hero, I patrol the kingdom's border and destroy any vermin threatening the nearby villages, and this is one of the places I use as a camp. If you're interested, I can tell you the history of these ruins.
Meow.
[BLUE](It seems Dominic and his friends have started a showdown in town!)[]

Good. And finally, an experienced coachman who can easily get you away from the robbery and, if need be, shake off a pursuit. You'll handle the search, and meanwhile I'll try to find out anything I can about the Whitetoads' residence.
We've come to take the horse stolen from Dominic, and you won't stop us, freak!
Well, to start with we need a decorated tree, a fir, to be exact. It'd probably be best to bring it here.
Your games are over, freaks!
Bless this Orc Axe.
Anita told me the sword is with a thief; I need to find his hideout in the Emerald Valley.
You spent a wild night, but got up in the morning full of energy. The girl was no longer in the room.
I hope the troubles with these necromancers are over now.
Reforge this mace.
Do you know what this Curse is?
Thanks for helping me beat those freaks, friend! These parts are far too dangerous to wander alone!
Fine, it doesn't look like you'll freeze in this place or be bothered by insects. Let's go find the way out.

[BLUE](The girl rolls onto her back, settles more comfortably on her bed of branches, and looks at you)[] Well, I overestimated my strength and abilities again, but you came to the rescue just in time. These crazed people wanted to roast me and eat me. Good thing they only tied me to that spit instead of using it... as intended.
I have no need of coin.
I met Princess Bernadette, who took me to the royal castle.
[BLUE](A fairly young-looking wizard looks at you condescendingly)[] Leave me alone, I'm busy.
I don't want to rest.

Hm, ten? It feels like only yesterday we said goodbye at the northern pier... You, I see, haven't changed much since. Well, since you're here, you must have decided to keep the promise you made me when we last met. Do you remember it?
Then let's not waste time. Let's get to work.
A Test of Honesty
I need to beat you up, wherever you are.
We can come to a peaceful agreement.
Thanks, I don't need anything.
[BLUE](Step in and help the lad)[]
Can you enchant this longsword, Sacrifice?
Nobody knows for sure. But he was killed with magic.
Well, it looks like we're done here. He won't cause us any more trouble. And now about your reward, hero.

Yes, that's the simpler way, but since I started all this, I'll see it through and win this lady over! But I can't do without your help. Because of the guards I couldn't fulfil her request, so you'll lend me a hand.

The fortress is north-east of here, in an area the locals call the "Hidden Plateau". First you need to reach the lake fort, where a boatman I know will take you across. As for how to get inside: if you're mighty enough, you can try to break through the guards, but there are rumours of dungeons under the fortress. If you can find the entrance, you may manage to reach the library unnoticed.

Then it's a deal; as soon as I find a suitable place for you, we'll meet in Icemist. Now about our business. Balthazar has protected his tower with a magic field that keeps outsiders out, even by teleportation. But I have an artifact that opens a breach in any protection for a couple of moments, enough for me to teleport to him. When you go back and Balthazar decides to show you his device, that's when you activate my artifact, and not before; the thing only works once, and finding another like it isn't easy. Is that clear?
I need to bring Evelina to the captain of the guard in Istril and report that the orc problem is solved.
In the forest by the quarry I found a body torn apart by beasts, most likely Kriop's, and also Scarlett's bow. I need to go back to her, tell her what happened and return her bow.
Nope, he's a cheapskate, and I don't talk to cheapskates.
The forester said he saw Prince Vardie on the snowy plateau in Dreamsnow Valley, but he doesn't know how to get there. Perhaps the royal rangers know; their camp is in Dreamsnow Valley.

And for Ilmara we're preparing an exclusive show: a charming holy warrior woman who slays any undead with her sexiness! I'm designing a special costume, like a metal corset as armour and a chainmail skirt that leaves her butt cheeks bare. In this costume, with a wooden sword, she'll whack the backsides of men made up as zombies! Do you happen to know a cleric girl for the role?

Aha, and here's the second goat! Were you eating our mushrooms, you scum?! Do you know that those mushrooms are our relatives?! Quite possibly you fried and ate my little brother or sister, you freak!
It's simple. I'll arrange to meet them after dark outside the city walls, somewhere to the south, and you'll get rid of them, and then nothing will connect me with them anymore. Agreed?
You're Sir Damian? I was looking for you at Sir Irolio's request.
I have the required ingredients with me.

[BLUE](In the castle courtyard the brave souls who answered Amos's call have gathered, ready to storm the castle and waiting for you. But suddenly white smoke fills the courtyard, and vampires led by their lord begin to emerge from it. Baring their fangs, the vicious creatures clearly want to feast on your blood!)[]
[BLUE](A kind-looking warrior woman who seems to be in charge of guarding the castle)[] Welcome to our city, traveller! No doubt you'll enjoy your time here!
They clearly won't give us time to think about what to do.
Isn't this thing a bit too thick?
Job done? Good. The boss of those girls won't calm down that easily, which means it's time to settle this with her for good.
What do you have for sale?
Honorary Guardian Nabiya asked me to rescue High Priest Killian and his men, who went into the barrow; I agreed to help.
Hey, you teleported me here. Maybe you can help me get back?
Meanwhile I'll get ready and head to New Garand to meet your boss. We'll meet there when you've finished the job.
And maybe I should find Tol himself for you too? Or the road to the realm of the dead? That I can arrange for you quickly with a sword, and I'll take your stone!
I'd love to, but I owe a lot of money to bad people, so if I don't pay the debt, let alone if I try to slip away from here, they'll kill me.
[BLUE](Your attention is caught by another device with a big magic light blinking on it. Neither the mage nor his apprentice has noticed it)[] And what's this contraption, and what does it do?
Well... I'm the one who freed the witch queen from the statue... But it was as if someone was controlling me, making the decision for me.

[BLUE](The young-looking sorceress looks sadly at the monster's corpse)[] A pity it turned out like that with him, but we had no other choice. All right, I'll tidy up here. Don't wait for me. I'll go to Hugh without you. It's better not to be seen in Icemist with shady types.
Hi, good to see you again!
I'll hurt you very badly. I'll break you completely, despite your pleas, until you tell what Sansa wants to know.
Magister Mundric agreed to give me the key stone from the Temple of Knowledge if I bring him a purple medallion.
Where can we find him?
Put your hand on the door and hope for the best.
Calm down, hero! We're not plotting anything bad or doing anything wrong! It's just an old abandoned tower we want to get into. There's nothing criminal about it!
[BLUE](This seems to be the entrance to the main vault, but a magic barrier blocks the way. You need to find its key)[]
Hi, Gigi, I'm here on the boss's errand. We need to find one of the feuding groups of sorcerers who practise some special magic that supposedly lets you grow yourself all sorts of things.
I feel like I'm running around naked! Give me good armour!
[BLUE](the man's already bulging eyes widened even more with fear)[] Your... Your Highness... this... this is some mistake... I... I can explain everything...
Then again I'll go alone first and scout everything out, and then you'll catch up.
Then let's get to work. Where exactly should we look for this mad wizard?
You're too categorical. You won't be alone in the Council...
Not far from Kingsbridge. Christine will go with you to help you with this task, and you'll help them too, since you had nothing to do with this kidnapping.
I helped the missing villager return to the village by Dawn Lake.
I delivered the gatekeeper's message and received a reward from him.
How horrible...
Layla owes money to local bandits; I offered to get rid of them. I must kill them in a rented house she'll lure them to at night.
Of course.
Reforge this greatsword.
Well, that's what I'm saying: a couple of days in Lannegar and a week in the woods, that's how we live...
What is there for me to talk about with you, necromancer?
Thank you. I'm developing a new recipe for our brewer and I need blue seaweed. It grows on the warmer sea shores. Could you bring about six of it?
Oh come on, how could he be dangerous? He ended up here by accident and got trapped. He'd clearly be glad to be freed and go back home!
And this fellow will help us get the artifact?
[BLUE](The mortal remains of one of the prisoners. Next to him you notice a steel key. Perhaps it opens one of the gratings on this level)[]
Then we go back to town.
Woof-woof.
The Archon and I must reach the rebels unseen and deal with them.
Enchant this Mighty Power.

For sorceresses that's no problem, especially for one as inventive as me! [BLUE](The girl takes out of a drawer a thing imitating a man's member and, with her hands, brings it to working readiness as if it were real)[] My special toy! But that's nothing compared to what they're used to getting up to here in Icemist!
I must collect the body of Adaon's double from the cemetery on the outskirts of New Garand.
I don't need a reward. As I said, I was bound to do it.
What you want from me?
I need to bring something that belonged to the founder of Castle Storme to the necromancer Gwen in the Deadwood. Perhaps Grissenda's sister can help me.
Looks like that's what we'll have to do.
Ha! Then let's find out who's stronger, you or me!
Do you seriously think your childish grudges are more important than family? You don't care that you're going against family with the bastard who kidnapped my son?
We can help you deal with this problem.
Yes, I'll take the job.
I want to thank you again for your help! We're going to bring in more righteous people to study the curse of the burial mound, so we can defeat this evil once and for all.

Everyone here? Excellent! The time has come to finish the nobodies who wouldn't let us live in peace! I'll screw over every queer hiding in this hole until they're all dead! Let these brutes get what they deserve! No mercy!
As you can see, the guards pay us no attention and the other gangs treat us with respect or leave us be. We don't have much to complain about.
I'm Bridge's girlfriend, or boyfriend, whatever you like. What do you want?

The best and strongest moonshine in town, made by me personally, for [BLUE]2 coins[] a shot.

Maybe he could help us. Where can I find him?
Are you a fool, or have you forgotten there are other lords down there? They'll call us to account if we screw up, and they're unlikely to be as merciful to us as Alaric was!

This looks like a teleporter, but it isn't working. Perhaps if we activate it we can leave this place! These obelisks seem to be connected to the portal somehow; with them we can make the teleporter work.
Rise, army of the undead!
As if you've ever hunted yourself?!

Hello!

I'll try.

Hey, Vince, what the hell, I thought we had a deal? And what the hell is she doing here?!
I'm not going to touch that thing.
No wonder. Dilettantes like you shouldn't be exterminating undead; that is the calling of paladins and the holy brothers and sisters!

I'll hand this body over to the mages. It'll be terrible if it turns out to be true. And you, sister, go back to your post immediately. We'll talk later without outsiders. For your efforts, traveller, receive this reward.

[BLUE](turning towards the noise, you see a group of brigands coming out of the forest)[] The Archon was right that someone else would come here, and you, moron, didn't want to wait, you wanted to clear off right away.

Hm, I have some unused fringe, and some knitted toys. I think they'll do for decorations. I'll get everything ready, and you'll bring the fir here yourself. By the way, a group of woodcutters recently went into the forest to the north-west. I'm sure if you find them, they'll help you find and cut down a suitable tree.
[BLUE](The picture of the sun goes dark)[]
Here's the ring that belonged to him.

[BLUE](A fairly young-looking wizard eyes you suspiciously)[] Hello, poor fellow. Another victim of Astutus's arrogance? Well, you're not the first and certainly not the last to get kicked out because of his stupid whims. We treat people more sensibly in our company, so welcome, if you want to stay and be useful.

Welcome to my laboratory, traveller. Would you like to look at my wares, or do you need healing or mana restored right here?

Our prisoner told us where to find the man who hired them. I sent my lads there, but that type turned out to be just a middleman. Vince easily cracked him and found out that the main employer is a certain Baron Enterprise.

I watch the bastards in all the kingdoms who might threaten Varsilia's security, and I study them closely. And now you've become one of my main targets. Before, your gang sat quietly and didn't draw my attention much, but now your cutthroats are running riot in the towns and on the roads of Varsilia in broad daylight. You'll have to answer for that.
Enchant this Staff.

[BLUE](You come to in pitch darkness)[]
Yes, I have it.
I must meet Anita at Castle Storme.
Enchant this Mage's Wand.

Some of my lads managed to bribe one of the street ladies, and she gave away the location of their boss's hideout. I've sent a squad of my best cutthroats to deal with her. Go to Mount Storme and help my lads.
I have a Potion of Moderate Healing!
Here's the key with the number. Go upstairs and find the right door.

Maybe we shouldn't involve the magister? You heard what happened to Fiydon: as soon as he agreed to help us, he was declared some kind of necromancer, and then he disappeared; most likely he's already been killed. And sending Lukan to Istril isn't the best idea either; he talks too much and draws too much attention to himself, and he doesn't look respectable enough for negotiations with decent people.
The team assembled to destroy the demon bear will wait for me at the camp in Dreamsnow Valley; I need to prepare before joining them.
Give me the Temple!
Morgen! It's not too late, the curse can't have taken full control of you! Fight it! Keep resisting and you'll break free of it! And together we can defeat the evil that dwells here!
I told you, you dimwit, I didn't take anyone's money!
And what was the point of this senseless performance, Your Highness?
You know, I'd gladly become better, but there's no room left for better.
What? How do you know anything about the Magister and the Forsaken? Wait a moment... Could you be the archmage's child he's looking for?
What donation exactly is needed?
[BLUE](It seems the guards don't believe you)[] Don't wriggle, you clearly didn't end up here by chance! You'll come with us together with this rascal, and explain to the praetor who you are and why!
Go, Jack, I believe you won't let me down. And my new brother and I will find that bastard Durant!
All right, let's go.
Glad to help your city.

There seems to be nothing difficult about it; the main thing is to find the right place. The castle has dungeons, doesn't it? We'll activate the seal somewhere in the middle of them so that its aura covers the whole mountain.
Shut up, scum! Think you've beaten me? Don't celebrate too soon, you wretch!
Really? And you couldn't ask him politely? Oh well, if it's a fight, let's fight!
Do you know what really happened here, and why the castle was sealed?

Hmm, that is a radical solution, but you are right: even if we manage to stop the spell with the totem, the cursed mage could create another, and we would have to find a way to protect ourselves all over again.
If you're ready to help Hermes, I'll reward you for freeing him!
Really? What's the problem, Alarion, don't you trust us? And I thought we'd already become close friends after what we had to do together.
I must return to Castle Storme to find its founder's notes on how to defeat the vampires.
I met the novice Hank, who told me about a missing party from Rigordion; I agreed to help him find them. First I need to explore the abandoned mine north of the Coal Quarry.
Hm... Well, that's how it is! You're right, I'm clever... Yeah, very clever...
Looks like we beat them all! I'll hide in Lamis until the dust settles here. Thanks for the help, I owe you. We'll meet there!
Well, if you don't want to become a lifelong cleaner of the Icemist sewers, tell me who paid you.
Thank you for agreeing to help me.

Actually, no. The adventurer was so glad to get out of there alive that he didn't bother leaving even the slightest notes about his route. He only told me he'd explored the caves in the Crimson Hills and in one of them found a way into the diggers' tunnels, which he followed all the way to the Temple of Knowledge.
It's simple: small, divided groups are far easier to manipulate than large organisations! It's just a dirty business, for the good of the whole kingdom!
I. Am. In. Her. Place.
You tire me with your empty chatter.
I'm fine. A vampire attacked me, but I managed to defeat it.
I will switch to energy-saving mode. Perhaps the remaining battery charge will last until my hardware fails completely and I cease to exist.

There's a cave in the Wyvern Mountains. He lives there.
Wow! What a big... I meant your sword! It's so big... Um, what did you want?
