Have you completely lost your mind, brother?! If the fate of our world were left in your hands alone, it would soon turn into Tol's own paradise! Where do you think you're going without a sword that can destroy vampires and the seal to lock them in their lair? Otherwise they'll keep coming out and attacking us forever!
Enchant this Bluesteel Axe.
Oh, then I'll talk to our Lady. Maybe she'll assign someone to help us! See you in Lannegar!
Nothing yet. Come tomorrow.

I must meet the Archon and the pirates west of the Dragon's Nest at the river mouth. Princess Bernadette told me not to tell Prince Alarion about her plans, but it's still worth passing this important information to him to help his cause.
Can you enchant this greatsword, Bloodsucker?
Well, that's worthy. Carry out one more errand to test what kind of warrior you are, and I'll take you onto the team for the holy mission.
Hi, what do you do here?
Let's hurry before something's done to our girls, all right?
And how about this, just think: you can keep the whole sum instead of hoping to get only part of it, and no one will hold you to account. We'll deal with your employer if you tell us where he is.
Your opponent chickened out, and there's hardly anyone here who'd dare fight you, so it's only fair to declare you the champion and the strongest woman in all the kingdoms!
But better than spending years trying to succeed with performances, mostly in some backwater.
Of course I will. The city is my element, and my tongue is my main weapon. You know that...
Correct, next question! While in the Elder Forest location, which location can you not reach?
The villagers were killed and turned into zombies! But it seems some of them were taken to Castle Storme; I must save them.
I found the ancient seal; now I need to meet Anita in Freetown to discuss the search for the sword that can kill the chief vampire.
Fine, let him stay, as long as he behaves himself...
We need Johnny alive, so if he acts up, don't overdo it calming him down.

Something quite obvious. The war with Mercia has drained the royal treasury, and the current taxes are not enough to restore it to its former level with the constant expenses. So why not make all kinds of riff-raff, like whores and bandits, work for the treasury? They are part of this kingdom too, after all. And the king can remain in ignorance with his moral principles intact; he doesn't need to know where the coins in his treasury come from!
Well, let's see what you've got.
Hey, silly girls, pack up your circus! Boxing and wrestling are men's sports, no place for women in them!

Thank you, my friend. The problem with the nasty ladies is solved. A pity it had to be done this way, of course; I tried to settle it all peacefully. We'll take over their boss's enterprise so it doesn't go to waste. And here's my thanks for your help.
[BLUE](An ancient stone altar with a blue stone set on it)[]
I know that Alarion is a prince and the main heir to the throne.

True. My sister nagged me to death with her talk that her son had long deserved more than the post of captain of our fleet's flagship, so I had to send old Falius into retirement and give his post to Dariel, so she'd finally leave me alone. Ah, sometimes I think it's time for me to retire too, but finding a worthy replacement keeps me from such a hasty step.
Freedom or Death
He who never swam never drowned, and he who drowned has drowned.
Then let's go.
I've no idea who he is, but I followed him, so I could find him if he didn't pay the rest of the promised sum for our work!
This is the last warning!
I enjoyed travelling with you again. I'll rest, and we'll see each other later, all right?
Now he looks even more disgusting than before.
No, we haven't gone into the castle itself yet.
Something must have survived here?
Let's get to it.
My brother is polite and noble, but I'm not. I'm not going to put up with white bastards here and coddle them! So get lost while you're still in one piece!
[BLUE](the tramp immediately jumped back from you and, howling with fear, ran away without looking back)[]
Seriously, you're boasting about beating such a weakling?! And what threat could that bare-assed fool and her zoo pose to the kingdoms with their huge armies?!
No, wrong guess...
All right, let's get down to business.
Then what are you waiting for? Let's see how you prove to me how much of a man you are.

[BLUE](A very pale girl dressed in some rags that do nothing to hide her slender body)[] Oh, I underestimated you, but you're not my problem. I'm not the one who dragged you here, and I'm out of here! [BLUE](The girl turns into white smoke and vanishes)[]
It happened near the Royal Lake. If your people go out on the Istril road, Captain Titus, maybe they'll find my things.
Gang, to arms! These bastards won't take us so easily!
Although I couldn't save High Priest Killian and his comrades, I was able to return the relic and received Honorary Guardian Nabiya's thanks.
A little green man told me I'll find the forester in the mountains, which I can reach by jumping over the pit.
As I promised, we're here.
You'd better not know exactly what lives on the other side of the island. You should run and save yourselves before it's too late!

Evidently Balthazar trusts you, since he invited you into his tower and gives you errands. That's what we'll use: thanks to you I'll be able to get into the tower and stop the madman before he activates his machine. You won't go unrewarded; I'm a rich man and won't be stingy with gold.
All right, thanks for the advice.
[BLUE](Side with the mage's apprentice)[]
Great, I have that armour with me: Disgusting Armor.
And you need help dealing with them?
Then why did you come, guard?
No, but I advise you to drop into the Istril tavern. It's always full of rumours.
Yes, but where should I look for these creatures?
Your zeal is commendable, but first I must see how good you are as a hunter. Get trophies from six polar bears and ten snow wolves, so I can be sure.
[BLUE](This is a magic door. There's no way to open it and go out)[]
[BLUE](This dead man seems friendly)[] Ah, once, like you, I was young and handsome, full of strength! But then I suddenly decided to get married, and now I've become what I am...
I choose the coins.
[BLUE](The creature's fiery eyes seem to look into your soul)[] Easy! Don't panic! I'm not going to fight you. I just need to talk.
Did you really doubt me, my love?
I promise I won't tell anyone about this incident.
Here's the manticore stinger you asked for.
I got a dragon heart; I need to return to Gigi so she helps me reach the leader of the sorcerers' faction.
And where's granny?
We'll help you beat them all.

[BLUE](He doesn't get to finish: there's a crash from above, and through the ceiling, collapsing in several places, a group of big armoured men drops into the hut. One of them starts yelling loudly)[] Freeze! Faces on the floor! Varsilian special guard!
The sergeant at the northern checkpoint said the zombie clergymen should be looked for in the Royal Forest near the old royal castle.
Dragons are too cliche! Who cares about some dragons?
As I understand it, you're the one hired to shut the mouths of talkers who are too clever?
An arcane knight? No, I haven't met anyone like that here, but I can help you find him. Or rather, these ruins will help us. There's still enough magic left in them.
Definitely.

Villagers by the southern wall of the city report that some creature has wandered into the southern reaches of the Chill Shore, something like a mix of polar bear and man. The creature attacks travellers, luckily without deaths so far, but sooner or later someone will die, so this creature must be exterminated.
Now that piece of shit definitely won't get up again!
Another head will appear on the wall today, and it'll be your own, and I'll take your stone!
Good. All of you survivors who chose to back that rat can clear off while I'm feeling kind, but if we meet again I'll finish you without another word.
Well, I have an acquaintance in Freetown. She's a big fan of yours, and she'd love to read your new poems.
Well, it seems your rosy plans are not meant to come true!
What? You seriously think some spell has taken control of me? Fool! I did everything of my own free will!
All right, here are the coins.
Take the cloak.
Hold on, you're white-skinned yourself, actually.
Greetings, wanderer. Our errand could be very dangerous. Prepare yourself well.
Damn, looks like they've set an ambush for us!
Yeah, run faster, before we decide to catch you and break your arms and legs!
So, while in the Elder Forest location, which location can you not reach?
I don't know how you managed to talk Hilt round, but the first cart of iron has already arrived! Meanwhile I'll talk to our potential buyers. It'd be good to get at least fifteen more bear hides.

Enchanting daggers and swords will cost [BLUE](200 to 300 coins)[], hammers and axes [BLUE](250 coins each)[], and anything heavier [BLUE](over 350 coins)[]. Making the amulet will cost [BLUE](650 coins)[]. If you have something suitable and the right ingredients with you, I'm ready to get to work right now.
[BLUE](This warrior isn't much in the mood for talking)[] Greetings, traveller. The roads in these parts are very dangerous. If you're going to travel, better choose the sea route.
Percy suggests breaking into the suspect wizard's house; for that I must get a device from his acquaintance Elle.
But you once said of Lukan's death that it must not be in vain and he must be avenged.
I'll try to find him.
Um, Holland Storme?
Hi, the boss is in, if you need to see her.
Violetta must be there already, waiting for us.
The wife of the governor of Freeport was robbed, and on his orders the city has been sealed off. Perhaps I can help catch the criminals; first I need to talk to Praetor Anwar.
What championship?
Let's go!
Suit yourself!
I must find the necromancer who lives in the Deadwood near Kingsbridge, to contact the spirit of Castle Storme's founder with her help.
Honorary Guardian Nabiya asked me to rescue High Priest Killian and his men, who went into the barrow; I refused to help.
Greetings, friend! Completely free of charge, I can help make your life in the kingdoms easier! What do you wish for?
[BLUE](You're about to answer, but you're distracted by a breathless elderly man in a robe who comes running out from behind a house)[]
Excellent! Then we'll start the search there. Meanwhile you can prepare for the mission. The team and I will be waiting for you at the eastern outpost of Dreamsnow Valley.

Hi, little brother. So the boss filled you in? Here's the deal: Johnny has disappeared and we need to find him. He usually hangs out in New Garand in one of the dorms. No idea if he's dumb enough to hide there, but we should check that den anyway, maybe we'll be lucky.

I managed to find old traces of their stay in this little village, and I suspect they then went into the abandoned mine whose entrance is north of here, but going in there alone with my gear would be foolish. But maybe a hero like you will do a good deed and find these poor fellows, and the High Priest of the Northern Kingdom will reward you.
I destroyed all the seals holding the being from other worlds; now I can discuss my reward with it.
Maybe you don't care, Pandora, but I find it kind of gross to think I was sort of sleeping with my own brother!
Yes, I'm his friend, and you'd better let him go, or you'll regret it!

Well, that's not a very sensible decision, but if it succeeds, we'll be rid of further problems this nasty baron could cause us. And clearly that idiot Rickman won't manage without our help. Go with Agnes to New Garand and help him. I'll join you later too.
Do you know how to get there?
See, nothing bad happened to you. They're just good, tasty mushrooms, right? I know my mushrooms.
Not yet.
[BLUE](This dead man seems friendly)[] Anchor down my throat! A fresh new one has come aboard?!

Excellent. One group has settled in Solliga. It's led by a certain mage, Lexus the Defender. The second group was once in Solliga too, but after the feud between them started, they moved here, to Icemist. Their leader calls himself Magister Astutus. I only deal with Astutus's group, since he strikes people off his trust list for any ties with the other group.
I wouldn't mind, but I haven't finished my last order yet. If you help me, I'm ready to work for you.
Great, I have that armour with me: a Charmed Robe of Adept.
Yeah? Then why didn't you drag him straight to Alaric, instead of staying here alone with him?
And who is this Bernadette, the woman who came to the governor?
Hmm... I need to think... That's not a simple question. This place... Hm, now I'll think some more...
On the road between New Garand and Kingsbridge I came across a bandit and a girl quarrelling; I helped the girl pay the bandit off.
It's sad that we had to do that to him.
The governor of Istril asked me to find and kill an evil mage; I refused.
All right, I hope so. If you like, you can stay and watch our rehearsal.
As you wish.
Twice as much as last time.
[BLUE](A fairly young-looking wizard eyes you suspiciously)[] This doesn't look much like a working laboratory.

Well, um, the deputy head of the magic council proposed a way to restore the minds of the crazed people in the area and wanted to test it himself. Many council members supported his idea, and I volunteered as a helper. [BLUE](The girl raises one of her legs to stretch it)[] My task was to find some small group of the crazed.
Thanks!
Hey, I think you'd better leave our settlement! We have enough problems here without you! An invasion of the dead, and what's next? Sorry, but we'll be much calmer without you around!
Oh come on, don't start again. I've come to you on business, actually.
A staircase leading down into the dungeon.
Maybe we shouldn't go in there?

Hm, once you've convinced this Shenron that the crown is useless, try visiting my older brother. He's the finest smith who ever lived on this earth. Though this object is disfigured, it should still hold crumbs of ancient magic, and he could try to reforge it to use the remnants of its former power.
We don't need many people for this job. I'll go to Istril myself, and I hope you'll join me, hero.
Bless this Heavy Scimitar.

Quite possibly, but it has to be looked into carefully, so I'm turning to you. The rest of the gang doesn't need to know yet that one of them is a rat. Vince is the man I trust most. I've told him what happened, and he'll help you with this.
I hope we'll find this spotted swamp creature, right?
[BLUE]a motionless body in a ditch, reeking of drink[]
My work on this armour will cost you 300 coins, and I'll also need three white wolf pelts.

I heard the monster had returned too, though I hoped it was just an ordinary man-eating bear on the prowl. Well, maybe good warriors can deal with it. You should look for the monster somewhere by the eastern mountains, though I'm sure it'll find those who go after it by itself.
I'll go to Nivarian, my friend, and tell my sister the good news. See you later.
Read something from the beginning.

[BLUE](Bubba falls to his knees. The handle of his hammer has broken and the hammer itself flies aside. Tossing away the useless handle, he draws a terrifying-looking dagger)[] No, I'm not going to give up that easily, the fight is only beginning!
How can I help you?
Don't waste your last breaths on pointless words. Everything's clear as it is.
I killed the goblin king; I need to take some proof of his death.
Enchant this Heavy Scimitar.
You move on to the other manuals.
Calm down. Who are you, anyway?
Shut the hell up, or I'll crack your skull and your little friend's! Hand over the magic key and you'll stay in one piece!
I'll be very glad if you change your mind.
The situation's lousy whichever way you look at it.
Great, I have that armour with me: Hardened Leather Leggings.
Thank you. I'm planning to hold a dinner for my colleagues and cook an exotic dish. For it I need the meat of the great apes that live far to the south. Could you bring such meat?
Great, I have that armour with me: Traitor's Chain Leggings.
Well, try it, if you're strong enough!
Magister Mundric agreed to give me the key stone from the Temple of Knowledge if I bring him a warg skull.
Go to the New Garand Farmlands. That's where we agreed to hold the meeting.
A bit far, but at least I haven't made trouble in that town yet.
Surely. Let's go back to her and find out.
Of course I saw her. Hard not to notice such a beauty! She was walking here in the square, spent some time by the alchemist, then went off somewhere.
[BLUE](A young-looking sorceress)[] Now I think leaving the city to wander the wild lands wasn't the best idea.
This lady must be very beautiful if you're taking such risks. Or is it all about her great wealth?
Then we'll persuade him otherwise.
And what do we do now?
I need to meet the gatekeeper in Istril to tell him I delivered his message.

Hm, Cryop? A couple of days ago I heard the local hunters say they'd crossed paths with some village hunter in the woods by the quarry, and they mentioned his name, Creep or Cryop. Maybe it's the hunter you're looking for, maybe not, but several days have passed since then. I doubt these tales will be much use.
Rrrawr-rrrrr.
Rhöneis.
[BLUE](a sturdy-looking old man with a stern face smiled when he saw you)[] Greetings, hero, I hope you'll find the boy.
I need to find the ancient seal that can lock the vampires in their lair; it's in an abandoned tower in the Zamohr Mountains.
Can you bless this thing? [BLUE](Show her the Oak Cudgel)[]
I have Deepfrost cognac, let's keep it simple.
That sounds dangerous. I think I'll pass.
Talking to you? Nobody would even stand next to a fright like you!..
As I learned, after that hero died, his sword was taken by a collector. Later he or his descendants founded the Golden Hand. Perhaps the sword is still kept by them.
And another bunch of trashy faggots got sucked in. Let everyone know Rickman is our real boss!
I already have a dragon heart.
Smooth talk. What do you say to that, Vince?

You lousy gerontophile! Maybe I should have called some necromancer to dig up and raise my great-grandmother? I'm sure you'd like her too! Jerk! [BLUE](The angry sorceress launches a bolt of lightning that roasts you thoroughly, then teleports away)[]
[BLUE](You spot the flowers you need, and just as you reach for them, you hear a shout behind you)[] Stop! Hands off the sacred flowers!
Great, I have that armour with me: Armor of Secret Guard.
[BLUE](the elderly wizard rushed to attack, and you have no choice but to fight him!)[]

What an unusual weapon! To lay the charms effectively I'll need other ingredients, namely seven human skulls and one demonic one. And because the work is difficult it'll cost more: [BLUE](550 coins)[].

Certainly, we could use a hero from outside! All our forces are busy keeping the enemy from breaking into the city, and there aren't enough people for other tasks. As it happens, the scouts spotted the orcs' warlord in their camp. If he could be killed, we could defeat their headless army. Reaching him won't be easy, but I guarantee a big reward from the castle if you complete this task.
Can you bless this greatsword, Widowmaker?
Shall I take you to Lady Ironstone?
Come with us, horsey. We'll take you home to your owner.
Thank you, I was glad to help.
Enchant this greatsword.

Oh! I admit violence and destruction aren't my thing. I'm more of a creator, but because of the high rent for my little corner of hell, I have to take side jobs like this. And I wonder, do you have an occupation you love, or do you also have to do work that doesn't interest you?
I need to find a suitable fir tree for the celebration in the forest near Whitetower; perhaps the woodcutters who went north-west can help me with this.
I must escort Sylvia to Nivarian.
Can you enchant this greatsword, Soulcatcher?
I'll be grateful if you make sure the princess is safe and report back to me.

([BLUE]An old-looking man with a scarred face who has clearly been in many scrapes[]) Aha. So you're the young hunter Whitewater was supposed to send? Hm, I'll have to work with what I've got... My name is Colt, and now I'll tell you about the beast you'll have to kill, or it'll kill you, whoever's luckier, ahem.
I need to return to Kiara in Liberty.

([BLUE]A knight in unusual armour, cleaning blood off his sword[]) Thanks, buddy, for helping me beat those vile creatures! Damned goblins, there are more and more of them every day, and nobody in New Garand cares what happens here, on the border of their kingdom! By the way, my name is Duncan.
All right, that freak has just sneaked into my home again. I hope you won't let me down. By the way, you can call me Sansa.
Fine, I'll keep that in mind.

It's your right to believe me or not. I have already accepted my fate, but I hope that one day people stronger and braver than I will reveal the truth about our king to the whole kingdom and rise against him. Hm, the governor will obviously demand some proof of my death from you; I wonder how badly you'll have to desecrate my corpse.
Well then, we'd be glad to learn something about who you are, and, uh, about the treasure, if there is any...
Outrageous! My appearance may confuse and mislead you, but I feel like a woman, I identify as a woman, I am a woman!
We couldn't find our friend here. Let's head back.
Nothing yet.
This is the entrance to the abandoned mine.
And what can you offer?
Go on, try to take it, old man!

A good deed! But here's the thing: recently rumours have spread that squads of zombies who were once clergy are roaming those parts. Such sacrilege is unacceptable! Whoever desecrated the bodies of our fallen brothers, the main thing is that they must be laid to rest once and for all. That way you'll pay them their last respects.

In recent years a lot of new faces have turned up in town and the competition has grown, but I'm still afloat, because one of the big enterprises is in my hands.
While you're still here, I wanted to ask you to help me with a difficult situation that a hero like you can handle!

Welcome. I represent the independent wizards and I'm ready to provide magical services to all in need, for an appropriate fee: teleportation, buying and selling magic items, elixirs, spells, or you can use the magic vault.

That's right, that's me. Your friends warned me you and their other companions would come here. I took them to that island and waited a long time, but they never came back. I had to return without them.
I must deal with the necromancer and the vampire lord.
A sorcerer? Well, see... a man comes to a sorcerer and asks him to make his dick reach the ground. The sorcerer thought about it and shortened his legs...
Do you know anything about the sorcerer who comes here?

[BLUE](A young half-naked woman with deathly pale skin sits on a stone by the shore, looking at you with interest)[] It's been a long time since I saw new faces on this barge. Pleased to meet you. But I advise you not to stay here long, and to be very careful.
I have nothing suitable. Sylvia, maybe you could make some clothes with your charms?

I've got some problems, and maybe you can help.
That'd be great!

Good luck to you.
I heard there's a tournament here for the strongest women, but they told me there's no one here in my weight class. Looks like someone turned up after all! Where is she?! Where is my opponent?!

And closer to the centre of the Seeing Hills is the Lake of Sorrow, with an island in the middle on which stands an ancient structure, the Lake Castle. I heard it was raised with the help of magic, which is why it has survived relatively well despite the years that have passed.
You won't leave me here alone, you'll free me, won't you? [BLUE](the naked girl locked in the cage looked at you pleadingly)[]
All right, where is the entrance to this dungeon?

We're surrounded by troubled places. We had enough problems with the bear-men, and now some black servants have appeared too. Every night they send evil creatures against our settlement, and I believe they're planning even more terrible crimes. I have few people left who can fight, and if you truly want to help us, I'll be very glad.
([BLUE]The wounded mage decides to surrender[]) It seems I underestimated you, and now I'm ready to accept your offer: to leave the Ironstones alone if you spare me.
[BLUE](Better prepare first before going down there)[]

[BLUE](a frowning man came up to her and took the message, watching you closely)[] Greetings, hero. We've heard of your deeds here; thanks to you the outskirts of Istril and the surrounding area have become safe. I'm glad to meet you.
Warning. Intruders. Detected. Proceeding. With. Detention.
Well, I hoped to change your mind, but now I see it's useless, and I'll have to use force to take this armour!
Yes, he lives in Icemist. I'll teleport us right to the doorstep of his house so the guards don't see us.
Take down the brute!
Buddy, enough time has passed. We should go back to Solliga, maybe Elizar has found something out.
Incredible! You did it, teacher!
I'll become a virgin again sooner than those dreams of yours come true!

Nothing much. First they declared me mad, then a witch, but I had no normal life left in the village, so I ran away. I lived as a vagrant for a couple of years, until I met a man with a taste for underage prostitutes. I'll gladly go anywhere if you rid me of these types! They usually hang around the pier on this side of the river at night.
I got the ice thistle seeds; now I need to return to Elle.

And here's the most intriguing thing I know. The ancient masters of magic could create so-called wandering stashes, which could be entered from any place enchanted for the purpose, if you had the stash creator's magic map with you. Now, I've found fragmentary accounts of an imperial hero who kept his unique armour in such a stash.
The demon bear is dead; the high priest of the temple of Rigordion is ready to reward me for my help.
[BLUE](A young sorceress who stands out for her large bust)[] Go give the dragon heart to Magister Astutus so he'll see you.
Dominic has set an ambush for a squad of the secret guard; I must help him defeat them.
Oh-oh-oh, these are our new costumes! Not everything's ready yet, so I haven't shown them to you. Though here, for example, is the tail for Violetta's costume.
If you're so sure of him, let's enlist this detective's support. Where will we find him?

Of course. A bit more practice, and together we'll reach the highest level of pleasure. By the way, for example, all these adventures of yours clearly aren't for me, but it's another matter when I'm with you: nothing threatens me, because you'll protect me, and I can give you my magical support. I'm sure we'll make a great team!
[BLUE](Suddenly undead appear out of nowhere, and an otherworldly voice begins to boom)[] Whoever you are, whatever you're doing here, I don't care. I'm going to devour all your souls!
I must deliver Grateroll to the magister in New Garand.
What a pity, though I myself stopped being into women long ago. If you were a man, I wouldn't let you go so easily.
Oh really? More empty talk?
Agreeing with them isn't the best idea, friend. I hope there'll be time to explain everything to you in more detail, but if things get really bad, I hope you'll bail me out!
Thanks for the hospitality. I have to go.

This fortress was built at the dawn of the empire, but none of its chronicles have survived to our day. The fortress survived the invasion of the horrors, and after they left and our kingdom was formed, it became the seat of the magic council. Who rules the tower now, nobody knows.
So what, do we take on this job, or will we have to pull it off ourselves without you?

Agreeing with them isn't the best idea, friend, especially now that we're outnumbered. I hope there'll be time to explain everything to you in more detail, but if things get really bad, I hope you'll bail me out!
[BLUE](A young pale-skinned woman glares at you)[] There's your spirit. Talk to it.
Ugh, turns out our treasure isn't that simple!
Lady Ironstone asked me to deal with a swindling sorcerer; I said I'd think about her proposal.
Let's not spread the word about... that.

Good. There's something else I wanted to tell you. Alarion is an overly secretive man. He has his reasons, but it sometimes keeps him from building strong, trusting ties, which leads to his plans being poorly carried out. So, you are a worthy person, Alarion himself speaks well of you, and since you've decided to help us, you have the right to know what you're getting into and with whom.

You judge me too harshly. Though I'm content with how things are, I'm not getting any younger, and someday I'll have to give this place up to someone stronger in body and mind, who'll carry on my work of keeping order and prosperity in our city.

Well, the grandpa from the lake told me about this city, and I wanted to see it and explore it myself. But I didn't believe the white monsters he scared me with really existed! I barely managed to run away from them when they suddenly appeared, and I hid here!
[BLUE](after this speech the man rolled his eyes while Evelina wasn't looking his way)[]
Bless this bone club.
[BLUE](You remember Sylvia, the Varannari girl you met in your house, but decide not to mention her)[] No, I've told you everything that was troubling me.
I helped catch the thieves who robbed the wife of the governor of Freeport and received a generous reward from him, but I angered the Seventh House.
I've brought your sword.
You did the right thing. I won't forget your kindness! [BLUE](With these words the robber vanishes into the night thicket of the forest)[]
I'm ready to accept any reward you like, my lady!
Hugh sent us.
The bandit offered me work with his gang; I need to talk to their boss.
Glad to meet you too. You're so pale. Are you ill?
Why do you need the bodies of these unholy creatures?
Magister Mundric agreed to give me the key stone from the Temple of Knowledge if I bring him deer antlers.
I found one Tolassian priest of the four needed.
Anyway, we can always run if things go badly!
Yes? A handful of ragamuffins who've probably already been eaten by spiders or wolves? And how many of those Varannari are still rotting in slavery or have already died in captivity?!
Times have changed here. Now the Seventh House controls all criminal activity and keeps increasing its share of any more or less significant haul, so formally I've retired from big jobs.
I must return to Lady Philippa's refuge to receive my reward.
Go on, try!
Pleased to meet you all.
So you don't have to sit here alone, you could come with me and help me on my adventures.
All right, so be it.
Well, as you wish. I will tell you the legend if you do me a favour.
Actually, we're looking for a sorcerer named Maurice, on Hugh's tip.
Kiara. Adaon is dead. The guards found his body near New Garand.
This is my home, and you have no idea what it took me to get it.
Glad I could help you!
Hm, a quite understandable wish for men. I see no difficulty doing it. Bring your friend to Solliga, find our man so he can bring you to my laboratory, and I'll do everything properly.
The blacksmith Hilt has started supplying iron for the venture; I need to tell Agnius.
Leave me alone, I'm busy!
That type did come to us, but we're not interested in getting into other people's feuds, especially since we found out he's tied up with some nasty lads. So he left with nothing.
I'm glad to hear such news. You must be a great hero to win that victory! But even if the curse is gone, I still have nowhere to go.

Because the book is in the library of a fortress, guarded by a big squad of Heavenly Knights and their sorcerers, and I'm not mighty enough a mage to deal with them all. Now you see why I need a brave hero. In New Garand I'm guaranteed over [BLUE]8000 coins[] for this book, which we'll split in half if you help me.
Um, well, the main thing is you're not hurt. Did you manage to, er... do your business? Can we carry on?

Honestly, not much. A young, mediocre wizard who took up treasure-hunting because he was weak at magic, though he was skilled at making glowing webs, which clearly helped him reach the Temple and return. No idea where he might be now.
I want the cat.
Be strong, don't give up. If they hit you, fight back. If you fall, get up. If you made a mess, clean it up. Nothing complicated about that, is there?
Fair warning, no hard feelings: if my kin start beating me, you'll get it too!
I must reach the dungeon's guardian and defeat him to open the way to the exit.
You must honour your ancestors. As my grandfather used to say: "I'm your grandfather."
Family Matters
Hmm... Thanks, but no. I'd better not touch it.
All right, I agree to the exchange.
I must deal with Bubba and his men.
Take me to father. I'll talk to him and settle this problem.
Then let's check what's going on in there.
I found 4 fiery cores, 5 more to go.
Yes, I'll help you rescue Dariel.
What kind of curse is it?

[BLUE](Your companion goes off to another islet, leaving you alone. You pull off your armour and zealously set about proving to the woman how much of a man you are. Her moans echo across the whole swamp for a long time)[]
That's clear, of course. Reaching mutually beneficial agreements is a long process. I also thought of proposing...
What is this barge? Where did it come from and where was it headed?
Then go back to the city. I'll finish here myself. When I get back, I'll tell the high priest to reward you for helping me with this errand.
I must help Zeref deal with Balthazar.
[BLUE](The highlander pathfinder silently waits for you)[]
I angered the Keeper of the Lost Kingdom.
You've been bad, so you'll be punished by me! Anything to say?
Sorry, but this is a risky business and I'm not ready to get involved.
Do you have any work for a hero?
What brings you to our city, if it's not a secret?
I need to find Vince; he went to Friguld to see the alchemist, perhaps I can learn something there.
And by the way, since you've already helped our city, would you mind carrying out one more errand?
Be careful! I wouldn't want you to go back to that terrible place, but I understand there may be no other way to defeat these dark creatures.
I fought the Heavenly Knights. You think I can't handle you and whoever your mercenaries are?
Of course, I wouldn't turn to just anyone. Hugh is the best heist planner in all of Versalia. So let's not keep him waiting, come on!
She's not my girlfriend, and the main thing is to find and deal with this stalker so he stops bothering her. Though, yes, she also asked to get her panties back, at least her favourite ones.
I helped the arcane knight Damian return from foreign lands.
I helped the villagers guarded by Captain Ribbonhair, and they rewarded me generously.

That's true enough, but I'm not some battle mage who wipes out enemies by the dozen. Besides, my real talents are useless, because these pirates have a shaman who can easily see through and dispel my illusions.
If you're that clever, maybe you can explain where I've ended up, what this place is?
I see, but I'm afraid now your pension is only guaranteed in the next world!
I'll deal with you and your master, whoever he is, and I won't let you ruin the holiday!

Oh, I can guess who you mean. Unfortunately, I've run out of those potions. They get snapped up so fast. He was trying to find out where else he could get such potions. He was very insistent, and reluctantly I told him about Skull Island. It's a very dangerous place. I tried to talk him out of it, but I fear he went there anyway despite my warnings.
And what if, before going back, he decides to take revenge for what happened to him?
Buddy, did you change your mind after all and decide to try my mushrooms?
All right, let's go.
[BLUE]A mage wrapped in furs nods gravely[] Wish to get out of this place? I can help you by using this portal.
All right, what do you need help with?

What do you want, master?

The courier from the castle who was supposed to deliver my reward has run off into the city sewers! I must catch him as soon as possible, or I'll be left without my reward.
We need to stay unseen so as not to draw the sentries' attention and reach these rebel idiots.
Too early to leave, the job isn't done yet.
It seems they don't know you shouldn't disturb girls in the middle of important business; clearly nobody taught them any manners.

My teacher's warnings about terrible invasions may be quite real. I'll figure out how his machine works so I can close the rifts, but in a way that's safe for everyone living in our world. Thank you for the help you gave my teacher. Farewell!

[BLUE](A grating blocks your way. Behind it a big, shaggy creature paces back and forth)[] Just our luck, another grating that won't open easily, and that's clearly where we need to go! And even if we somehow open it, there's some wild beast guarding the passage. We'll have to deal with it somehow, it won't just let us through!
[BLUE](A slightly gloomy-looking priest, glad to see you)[] Welcome to the temple of the Northern Gods, traveller. In our sanctuary any warrior can receive the blessing of our gods for a donation!
Very well, we agree to help you with this.
And what just happened? I didn't understand anything.
Great, I have that armour with me: a Lightforged Robe.
The alien is dead; now I need to talk to Balthazar.
Damn it! I always have to do everything myself! And where are the rest of those tattered whores?! I need you here!
I must pass a message from Boss Rickman to Lady Philippa.
Well, it's my personal business, but I'll be glad if you join me, brother.
All right, and what's this business?

Right, we'll head there. But first we need to find some clothes for Evelina, and her staff. [BLUE](first you searched the village surroundings and found a fine staff that clearly belongs to Evelina, then you searched the houses, found someone's cloak and handed your finds to the girl, who deigned to get up from her bed)[]

You notice no other clothing on her, but she doesn't seem to be cold)[]

Right. By the way, about the price, since you mentioned the haul. My rates have changed. Judge for yourself: the places we're going are dangerous, and lately there are many more patrol ships too. You'll have to pay extra for the risk.

If the cursed mage is the source of the spell, wouldn't it be simpler to kill him and spare ourselves the trouble? As I understand it he can't be cured of the curse anyway, and he may cause new disasters.
Here's what you wanted!
I made Dominic very angry.
Hey, I need to talk to you.
May the Northern gods bless you!
I want to enchant this Terrifying Shortsword.
The Archon and I must reach the rebels and deal with them.
I hope so. We should hold talks in a more peaceful setting; then we might be able to strike a deal that benefits us both.
We'll pick one of our most experienced allies from Sol-Laqueul.
Changing Hierarchy
Maybe you know someone who knows how to get onto this plateau?
Bless this Silver Shortsword.
I found four Tolassian priests; now I can return to Gwen in the Deadwood and give her the skulls.
Hi-hi! Glad to see you! We're going to hold a showcase rehearsal, and we've invited famous guest musicians for it! And how are things with you?
I found the courier's body, but the artifact wasn't with him; perhaps the orcs took it. Their camp should be somewhere nearby in the south of the Bluemist River.
I have no idea whether it's possible, but if I have to kill Morgen to free his spirit, I will.
Sir Irolio said the knight I'm looking for is called Damian and should be looked for in the White Plains or on the Deepfrost Glacier.
Me? I'm just a lover of exploring various antiquities, like the ruins we're standing by.
Ah, right! I remember, that was a tiring trip. I don't like being far from the sea for long. You haven't changed much since then.
You know, that's not the best way to say thank you. But either way, I have no strength left to resist.
Magister Mundric agreed to give me the key stone from the Temple of Knowledge if I bring him a Yeti paw.
That doesn't seem quite fair...
I couldn't find Vince on Skull Island; I need to return to Friguld and ask again about Vince's whereabouts.
Damned bitch! Filthy slut! How did you find me again!?
[BLUE](a girl with a striking look and unusual hair colour)[] Meet Mighty Rock.
This won't take long.
[BLUE](the huge winged creature suddenly vanishes just as it appeared)[]
I must deal with the inhabitants of the cannibal village.
[BLUE](The girl laughs)[] I'm a princess and I can do whatever I want, although of course I don't abuse that privilege. My talents are enough to get what I want.
I hope so, and that I'm finally free of this burden. How strange, I lived with that monster for so long, and such a life seemed normal to me...
Well, most likely you're supposed to serve the summoner, smashing and killing everything and everyone at his command.
[BLUE](The guards turn their attention to you)[] You! Stop! Are you this little rat's accomplice?!
I have giant mead!
Oh come on, Hugh, he's one of ours, proven. He's bailed me out a couple of times already, and he's not fool enough to share loot with the Seventh House hangers-on for nothing.
However hard it is, we'll find a way out of here!
Me?! No, and what does it matter whether I'm an outsider or not? All lives matter. I'll stop you from putting innocent lives at deadly risk, whatever it costs me!
He did. Now let's get out of here. I'll take you back to the settlement.
Here are the sabretooth eyes you asked for.
I helped Rickman keep his position as gang boss.

Oh, I know everything about you, Maxian. How you and your legion fought in the campaigns against the orcs on the west coast. And in the hunt for Varannari in Jabal. And how you fell in love with a slave and decided to marry her, and not just a slave, but a Varannari slave, for which you were thrown out of the legion in disgrace when the truth came out. And how your crimes landed you in a penal squad, and about your escape, after which you took up banditry.
First you need to study the right manual and check that you have the required ingredients.

The locals aren't very happy to see us here, so I decided to set up our camp here so as not to make them nervous, but some of the residents do seem interested, so we won't be left without an audience.
Oh-ho, good potions, solid potions. Potions to poison your enemies, and potions so nobody poisons you.

Died? I'm sorry. We walked into a pirate ambush. I drew all the attackers onto myself and told Vince to run to the boatman... so he didn't make it. And when I'd dealt with the enemies, left without transport, I decided to swim back to Friguld. Swims like that are no problem for me, I'm a former athlete after all.
You think this world is diverse and full of unique folk? Nope, there are only two kinds of people: me and everyone else.

You're just in time! My husband recently came back from his trip, very angry and irritable; it seems his joint venture with the sorcerer has failed. And one of my servants spotted the swindler himself in the "Merry Wayfarer" tavern; he's only just told me. If you hurry, you can catch the scoundrel there!
Yuck! Is this some kind of medicine?!
All right, let's do that.
I want you to follow me again.

Yes, I was told you'd come alone.

I'm Bridge! And you go wherever you were going!
Can we get out of here somehow?
I can teach you [BLUE]Necromancy[]. With it you can summon a spirit that will fight for you.
Step away from it.
We have far more important business, and this guy is always getting into trouble; he'll wriggle out of it himself somehow!
What happened here?
Bless this Silver Greatsword.
I helped Zeref get into Balthazar's tower.
Oh come on, Hugh, where else to do business if not New Garand itself? This is the richest ground for rich folk.
All right, see you. We'll carry on and visit Violetta in New Garand.

All right, thanks.
Great, I have that armour with me: a Tolassian Chain Shirt.
No need, you've done enough. I'll take care of the extra guards myself. I've just prepared drinks for them with a strong sleeping draught. Maurice, how's your sorcery?

Incognito, I carry on with the old trade, recruiting a team of accomplices from tight-lipped, proven people with no ties to the Seventh House. So we have a little problem right away concerning your new friend. I don't know him, and checking who he is and where he's from will take a long time.
Of course, but I think I've already given you an autograph? Oh, what does it matter! I've mislaid my favourite quill somewhere. Come tomorrow and I'll definitely give you an autograph!
In a sec.
There's no trust, and there can't be, in the words of bitches like you!
Don't worry, Mika, he won't get away from us that easily. One day we'll drive him into a corner he can't escape from.
All right, here are the coins. Talk.
Well, let's split the loot and scatter before the New Garand guard gets on our trail.
Yes, that's me. Who are you and what do you want?

What happened? You stepped over to the bushes, I thought you'd gone to relieve yourself, and then you came back a minute later. That's all. What's wrong? If you like, have some more mushrooms. There are plenty left.

[BLUE](Princess Bernadette came out of one of the doors and walked towards you, holding a small axe whose blade seemed to be stained with blood)[] Sorry for the delay, my guest wasn't very talkative, so I had to resort to unpleasant methods to loosen his tongue. You can tell your lady she needn't worry about her rival anymore.
At last, all the seals are destroyed, and nothing holds me back anymore! I am free!
I managed to kill the unknown knight and his men, though I never learned the reason for his hatred of the villagers.
Thanks, but I have to go.
I hope you've prepared well before setting off. When you've got the book, come back here!
I got an ursan's head; I need to give it to Magister Mundric.
Well, yes. That way it'll stay on more securely and won't fall off.
Damn it! These scoundrels followed you from the cemetery! I knew it wouldn't just end like that!
You can call me Shenron, and I have a job for you. You're clearly one of those adventurers who takes any job, no matter who from. What do you say?
My dear, you shared a secret with me, and as I promised, I've found this great wizard, who has already dealt with the moon curse before!
[BLUE](A red-haired girl who isn't in the mood for talking)[] Hi. I have no time to talk.

Go in.
Yes, I agreed that if I help him, he'll help me.
Alice and I found Layla and Violetta; now we need to return to Mikaela at the mistress's refuge.
[BLUE](A stone structure with recesses on each side, with stones set in them)[]

From time to time a boy from the city comes to visit me to listen to my stories about ancient times, but recently he stopped coming. I went to Rigordion to find out whether something had happened to him, and it turned out he really had gone missing!
I have Deepfrost cognac!

I found the third key stone in the Temple of Knowledge.
I must get into Balthazar's tower in the south of the Bluemist River.
Good. We have a guest today, but he won't disturb you; do everything as usual.

Uwaah, I'm a zombie, and you're a tasty lunch!

Hm, I'm not sure I can explain its nature in a way you'll understand. It all began... Oh, I can't even remember how it all began, it was so long ago. Perhaps he was the cause of what became of us, or perhaps it was me. But now nothing remains, only pitiful, dim fragments of memories...
I avoided taking part in the attack on the governor's son; now I must meet Alarion in the Royal Forest.
Go through.
What the hell?! How can you walk on air, and upside down too?!
Lady Ironstone asked me to deal with a swindling sorcerer; I refused to help her.
Enchant this Hunting Bow.
You could have told our friend that in advance.
Who are they?
This won't end here just like that! We'll meet again, hero...
I sense the wolves have come for my soul, and though their claws and fangs are sharp, I shall not fear or turn coward, I'll live again in spite of all...
In Rigordion I met Agnius Northson, who offered to make me a partner in his venture; I agreed. To start with we need to get 10 bear pelts.
So you're a princess?
Oh, great, let's hurry to a rented room!

Those people in the village surely need our help!
Kardagis agreed to solve the problem of Layla's debts if I pay 3000 coins.
I must reach the centre of the dungeon of Castle Storme so the wizard can activate the ancient seal.
The high priest of the temple of Rigordion is ready to reward me for my help.
So who are you, and why are you alone here in the middle of the swamps?

Nope. [BLUE](Evelina replied, waving a mosquito away)[] It probably survived from imperial times. [BLUE](The young-looking sorceress gives you an unfriendly look)[] No idea who you are, but you'd better back off quickly before I decide to turn you into slugs.

I must meet the dragon Shenron in the Great Plains to give him the Dragonlord's Circlet.
[BLUE](This woman is sober enough to talk to)[]
I'll try, Mika.

I have no business in there.

Not yet.
And if I refuse, what will you do to me?
I know my mushrooms. If you have doubts, try my mushrooms.
Yes, of course. To start preparing the spell, I need to know exactly which part of your friend's body needs enlarging.
The demon of the fiery altar agreed to teach me how to use the crystal, but I must pass his test of strength!
Give me the Lady of the Night!
[BLUE](The soldiers jump on you. You try to break free, but the soldiers have no intention of being gentle or taking you alive!)[]
Well. I don't know why you got mixed up with my lousy good-for-nothing, but you look like an honest person, so you'll do a job for me, and I'll give you the knife, whatever you need it for.
Excellent work, traveller. Now don't stick your neck out. We'll deal with these bastards ourselves.
Neville is in trouble again; I need to ask him about it.
What do I have to do?
I must deal with the Magister.
Sorry, but we've already been paid, and we can take your stuff off your corpse.
I must meet Boss Rickman and Agnes at night in New Garand.
How much will the enchanting and the amulet cost?
You asked for it. Take down these brutes!
Thank you for the gift.
Exactly! Behold and tremble: the legendary Dragon Lord's Crown and its owner, me, Shenron the Mighty!
Now we are ready to carry on with our assignment, but I must warn you: Magister Daggett is a mighty mage, and although he has gone mad he has lost none of his skill or power.
I killed the master of the fortress; now I need to find the way out.

Thank you. There are rumours on the black market about some purple medallions from a mysterious underground city. Perhaps they're magical. It would be interesting to study such a thing. Could you bring such a medallion?
What an unusual weapon! To bless it, you'll have to donate eighteen small diamonds and [BLUE](2500 coins)[].
I need a little time. This isn't magicking off a wart!
Keep a sharp lookout. Is it just me, or is there something moving in those bushes to our left?

I understand, but this is a very important matter; our future may depend on it, and I want everything to go perfectly. [BLUE](the man turned to you again)[] Thank you for bringing me this message. If you don't mind, another message needs delivering, and as a reward you'll get much more than the gatekeeper promised you.
No, but one of the local captains boasted he'd been there. He'll surely help you, if you find him.
Then good luck with that.
And how's that?
So, are we going to see this forester?
Let's go and find their cellar.
What magical services do you offer?

Let's have a look at them. Oh-ho, something's happening! Yes, they've joined into one piece! A couple of spells and the magic map will be restored. [BLUE](After the wizard's magical manipulations, the parts of the artifact merge, and he rubs his hands contentedly)[] Done! Well, now with the magic map you'll be able to find the stash in one of the ruins you've visited, and at last I'll get to behold the legendary armour of antiquity!
Seriously? Doing the holy folk's work while they lounge about somewhere?! Has that church run out of money or what? Can't they assign someone decent to guard that thingamajig?!
What do you say, kitty?
This seems to be a teleporter, and it's working.
I just wanted to ask: have you come across zombies around here that look like clergy?
Magister Mundric agreed to give me the key stone from the Temple of Knowledge if I bring him 3 mamba fangs and 3 coral snake fangs.
You know what happened to the last man who called me a whore. He went to feed the crocodiles, and you won't get off so lightly!
No idea, ask the clerics.

[BLUE](The young-looking sorceress, but this time she's wearing almost nothing)[] My hero and saviour, I see you dared to come to me after all to claim your reward. I thought about you and about a worthy gift for saving me, and I realised the best reward for you would be me.
Greetings. How's the search for the pieces of the magic map going? Or do you need one of my magical services?
We managed to find the ancient seal. What about you?
I helped the wizard from Istril get the unique Myrosian armour and was rewarded by him.
I'll be glad if you dig up any information at all on this bastard.
[BLUE](A short, fair-haired girl, immodestly dressed)[] Good thing that idiot only pesters Mika. Now she's less focused on dreaming up all kinds of nonsense!
Actually, I came to your lands from Varannar.

That doesn't actually matter! You can do backing vocals or backing dance, or be the service staff, or security. Or better yet, you can be the troupe's manager! I'm short of musicians in the troupe right now, and you can help find them and bring them into my wonderful troupe! What do you think of my offer?
All right, an ordinary spirit summoning. That won't be much trouble.
I must defeat the priest Morgen and the witch he swore allegiance to.
You're back? And not alone? Well, how did the negotiations go?
Hi, Mika. What are you up to here?
I found another key stone in the Temple of Knowledge.
I must meet Kiara in Liberty.

She has something we need to destroy the last seal! A kind of diadem, but she almost always has it on her, and it's not easy to get, so I decided to get close to this lady. But the process has taken longer than I expected.
Yes, I understand. I hope it all works out.
I'm ready to cooperate with you. It'll benefit you as well as me.

[BLUE](Dominic stands before a crowd of slaves and the cutthroats guarding them)[] These bastards put you in chains and think they can control you, but they can't! Freedom is yours alone and no one else's!
All right, I'll be glad to be a guest in your settlement.
All right, it's a deal.
I'm the novice Hank. More than a week ago a party set out from Rigordion to these parts on a holy mission. There's been no word from them since, and I was sent to look for them.

That's Lorcan, the son of one of the former royal guards. When he was a boy, his father took him along on the king's hunt near the Royal Lake. There he nearly drowned; they managed to pull him out of the water, and my father saved him, perhaps with the help of his dark arts.
The chief traitor is dead; now I need to talk to Kiara.
My work on this armour will cost you 350 coins, and I'll also need two white wolf pelts and two polar bear pelts.
And if I need another collar like that?
Use the password to open the door.
[BLUE](you see a magic window displaying a text message. The message is very dim, barely legible)[] WARNING: Power below operating level, please connect an auxiliary power source.
Go inside.

Well, excellent. Our job went quite well. We didn't manage to kill all the rebels, but we took the governor's son prisoner, and the pirate ship we seized helped draw attention away. By the way, I was just looking for you: Princess Bernadette wanted to meet you to discuss some new business.
Actually, you were the one seen at the scene of the crime!
That's a real bastard's way of doing things. Do you really get away with it?
Ladies' Man

Yes, exactly! Only this portal is one-way: you can come here through it, but not go back, so the orc leader was looking for a mage to fix the portal. But I'm no specialist in teleportation magic, and I'm not good with magical equipment and artifacts either. I have no idea how long I could have fooled them before someone finally rescued me.
What needs doing?
Clearly that witch's evil magic moved us here, but this place is unfamiliar to me.

Our feud with the bandits has been going on for a long time. We gave them chances to settle everything peacefully, but they didn't want that, so the time has come for more decisive and harsh measures. Especially since now we have an ally who's glad to help.
Captain Ribbonhair asked me to get rid of the necromancers by killing their leader; I agreed to help. Their lair is somewhere in the Seeing Hills.
I've brought the fir tree, only I found bodies of people torn apart by beasts. I'm afraid they're the woodcutters you talked about.
Go down.
Go back to the Lady.
The grating is open!
I don't need your help right now.
So the girls are safe and sound? Well, now we can deal with those scum seriously.
What should I do with this thing?
Take them.
Hi. I doubt they'll be happy to see undead in their towns.
The possessed have seized Evelina; I must deal with them to free the girl.
And how did that battle end?
[BLUE](an obelisk with a round hollow in it; perhaps it is somehow connected to the portal)[]
This is the exit from Sansa's house.
I meant that we can do without the wedding nonsense and help you with something concrete.
And I'll be glad to see you here again, and you too, Adaon. You can stay here for a while. Maybe it won't be so unpleasant to see you, and we'll find common ground again.
We've come to rescue the girl, and we won't leave without her, even if we have to kill every last pirate on this island!
All right, so be it. I hope we don't meet again. Next time I won't be so good-natured.
Actually, I'm already the boss, but let's fight by your rules and finally end the mess you've made in our gang. We'll meet at our old base.
All right, let's go to your Lady.
The hunter said the man-eating bear should be looked for at night in the forests of Lannegar Valley, perhaps by the road.
It's you who'll die right now! Boys, tear them apart!
I'm looking for Bridge's friends. Maybe you can tell me where to find them?
I told you, Archon, we shouldn't rely on riff-raff. They're no use, but they can blab and draw unwanted attention to us!
I think you misunderstood me. I'm not going to haggle with you. It's thanks to my leniency that you sail in this part of the sea and the patrol ships don't hunt you.
Lexus is dead; now I need to talk to Astutus about Vince's problem.
Here's the purple medallion you asked for.
I helped the runaway slaves escape from Mercia.
After the clash with the mad wizard I've ended up in a strange place; I must find a way to get out of here.
Damn it, the bastard slipped away while I was arguing with you! That's what happens when you have to deal with stubborn, sentimental fools!
The statue? Not really... Although I know a magister I studied under for a while. He was fascinated by that thing and studied it constantly.

[BLUE](the princess looked at you long and closely, but decided to answer)[] I intend to question him about his other friends who weren't on the island and whom he is connected with outside his city. If he isn't stubborn, he will stay alive and perhaps unharmed, and then I will use him as leverage over his uncle or my brother.
No, you're clearly one of the thieves! Soldiers, arrest him!
Captain Greedy turned out to be a scoundrel who hired heroes for dangerous work, then killed them and kept the reward; judging by the sum found in his stash, I was far from his first victim.
Brother Gabriel must be at his shrine right out in the street.
Enchant this Bluesteel Greataxe.
All right, I'll try to find something out from them.
Looks like we've walked into an ambush.
No, thanks, I've already tried your mushrooms. I don't need any more.
Don't worry, nothing will happen to me, and I'll take your new acquaintance with me so you don't worry about me unnecessarily.
Um, so you're asking me to help find your girlfriend's panties?
Where can you send me?
[BLUE](the device hums quietly and then spits out the card; you take it back)[] Access granted!
My work on this armour will cost you 200 coins, and I'll also need a white wolf pelt.
All your things are in this chest!
You'll still badly need the very best warrior.

They'll find me themselves. I'll call their boss a coward and challenge him to a race, and he'll have to accept so as not to be branded a coward in front of his men. I'll set up a night meeting on these plains, far from the eyes of the city guard, and gather my whole family to deal with the scoundrels. Join us if you want to help.
[BLUE](Alarion and the woman exchanged glances)[] Well, evidently you were right, Havis: he really is watching me and everyone I deal with.
I'm glad to see you too.
All right. Well, now it'd be good to find you some clothes again.

Hm, zombies? Yes, there was a soldier here once who babbled something about zombies dressed like holy men. I think he serves at the northern checkpoint in the Coal Quarry, if you want to find him and learn the details.
The sign on the door: members only. The door is securely locked.
I want to leave the castle.
We've been spotted! We'll have to fight our way through!
I found the magic eggs needed to destroy the containment seals.
Don't grumble, oak-head. I work for your king now too, actually. Didn't you know, or is your post too lowly to be told?
All right, I'll deliver these axes to you.

Uh... All right. So, what else? Ah, the owners are away at the moment, except for the eldest son, which means we must act as soon as possible. I think that's all. Although I can help you more. I'll try to distract the guards outside the mansion somehow.
Oh, it's you. I didn't think we'd meet again.
Hey, maybe we could put on a theatre show? We'll say the undead were part of our play and calm the locals down! And anyway, our own theatre is a great idea!
I'll give it all back, I promise! We'll do one good job with my new friend, I'll earn lots of coins and make up for all the losses you've suffered because of me!
I'm not going to repeat my demands!
[BLUE](a young man in nothing but his underpants jumps out of bed)[] Hey, I said nobody was to distur... Aaah! Help! Robbers! Help!
I've nothing to do down there.
Kneel before His Majesty King Kalion, first ruler of the lands... [BLUE](the richly dressed man began loudly, but fell silent when the man on the throne raised his hand)[]
[BLUE](Soon the legionnaire gets tired of your chatter)[] All right, maybe I was mistaken. You can go!
Perhaps you could help us by telling us about the moon curse, if you know anything about it.
Agreed! Poor Jes, he was the best at shoeing wheels and hooves! His killers won't go unpunished!

Lately I rarely forge new blades because of problems with ore deliveries, but I can reforge any steel weapon without charms on it that you bring me. For a moderate fee you'll get a better weapon than it originally was!
I found the lair of Mikaela's stalker; perhaps this time I'll be able to deal with him.
Hi there!
The goblin I know is very old and doesn't like being bothered over trifles, so he hides somewhere here in a secret place.
I got the device I needed; now I must meet Percy at night by the suspect wizard's home.

We've invited all kinds of musicians from all the kingdoms here! Not everyone answered, of course, but it's still packed! For example, a quartet of Varannari shaman rockers, or the industrial folks from Icemist, and there's a choir leader from Ilmara, and a folk singer from somewhere far in the south, and... oh, wait, who's that over there, I've no idea... Oh no! It's that stalker! How did he get in here!? Hold him!

Without any doubt, you truly are a great wizard! Here, take my diadem as a reward for lifting the curse. It's an ancient family heirloom, but I don't mind parting with it. You have defeated an evil I never hoped anyone could overcome!
You're still here? Go with Christine to the meeting, or have you decided to change your mind about the choice I offered you?
For a mage.

I represent the interests of Lady Philippa and her group here and speak on behalf of the whole collective. I hope we can reach an agreement, settle all the conflicts and come to mutual understanding and profitable coexistence.
Enchant this Bluesteel Dagger.
I'm Bridge! And you're a loser, ha-ha-ha!
There is something, but I'm not sure you'll succeed at it, much less get a reward.

[BLUE](This dead man seems friendly)[] Somewhere on the little island here lives a beautiful woman, though she's dead too! Only why have I rotted and gone off, while she stays just as fresh?! Not fair!
Well done.
Oh no, it's the evil ladies!

If you wish it yourselves, I won't talk you out of it. Remaining warriors, hold the mine entrance. I doubt the Varannari outside have the strength left to try to take the mine again, but we must be ready for anything.
Oh, that's so sweet! You're so good-natured, ready to accept even a rotter like me. But don't expect me to turn nice now! I'm used to taking whatever I want. I don't need anyone's handouts!
Great, I have that armour with me: a Forest Chain Shirt.
This is very bad. Let's search everything here quickly...
I found it in the mines of the Seeing Hills.
Hey, are you all right?

Well, mortals, I understand your impatience. Your lives are too short for long waits! And my gift to you will be a quick death, here and now, so you won't have to watch as I bring all my destructive wrath down on this world that dared to defy my will! And you won't be doomed to burn slowly and painfully along with your world as it turns to dust! Farewell!
[BLUE](Now you need to leave the city somehow without getting caught by the guards)[]

Their first priority was building the ship's reactor; it was developed in a separate laboratory far to the east of here. And that very place became the epicentre of the catastrophe that destroyed the nearby cities and changed this land.
I dealt with the bandits robbing people in the forest; now I need to return to Scarlett, tell her what happened to Kriop and give her back her bow.
I found the password for the tower door; now I need to find the Dragonlord's Circlet.
Death to the bastards!
What do we need to do?
I hope you've made a decision about my proposal?
Great, we managed to bag this brute! I'll deliver the ordered hide, and then I can work for you.
You cheat me! Me beat you!
Thanks again, my friend, for agreeing to help, even though Vince solved his problem himself. And this is my thanks for your help.
No, I'm not a farmer-merchant.
They're somehow tied to Adaon's murder and are trying to stop the investigation.
This seems to be the blackmailer's house his go-between talked about.
Boss, you're here?!
Well, your companion is a girl, and the sorcerers of both groups are mostly virgins who've clearly only really talked to a girl once in their lives, so she won't have any trouble with them.
I see my little sister has really messed up, and now once again I have to fix her failures.
[BLUE](Not far off, behind the trees, you hear some noise, someone's loud voices)[]
Thanks for the advice, I'll keep it in mind.
Kardagis solved the problem of Layla's debts; I must return to Kingsbridge and tell her.
The captain of the Istril guard asked me to solve the orc problem and find the missing sorceress on the Istril road.
Yes, we managed to catch one of the attackers. With his help we found the employer, who told us that Baron Enterprise is behind all this.
I need medium healing. [BLUE](pay 40 coins, heal 65 HP)[]
You've given invaluable help, hero. The high priest will surely reward you.

Whatever we sought in those days, we did gain immortality, but it became only an endless dragging out of a pitiful existence... I rarely have guests, so I like to talk and stir my memory. It helps keep the remains of my former self whole. But clearly you didn't come to me for no reason?
Law and Order
I need to meet Grissenda to talk about her sister, who may have learned something new about the vampires.
Sorry, but I have no strength for magic right now. But I promise, when we reach your city, I'll try to cover myself so as not to embarrass the townsfolk.

All right, if we have a deal, let's decide what we'll do. As I was saying before these dolts interrupted me, your deputy is gathering people, and there aren't many places where he can find worthy ones...

Putting up with Mika's company again is no great pleasure. On the other hand, the championship I organised turned out to be, to put it mildly, a flop, so I don't mind taking up something new. But who will be responsible for costumes and instruments? I still have a set of recorders, but that won't be enough to play songs well, and then there's the repertoire itself.
Of course, let's go to Lady Ironstone!
Nice to meet you, but I have to go.
This only strengthens my resolve. He leaves me no other way; I must act before it's too late. Especially now that the governor of Sol-Laqueul is ready to...
I hope so.
Pups? You mean the children? You want to kill the children too?
Senior Royal Ranger Haghenge told me the snowy plateau can be reached through the caves whose entrance is not far from him.
[BLUE](A young-looking sorceress)[] Oh, hi. I didn't expect to meet you again so soon.
Hello. I'm glad to see you, though there's nothing to be glad about right now.
In the square of Whitetower I met a little boy. He refused to talk about himself until I bring him something tasty; or I could ask the townsfolk about him.
That you're a damn man, not a woman! You're as much a woman as I'm a minotaur!

[BLUE](Alarion, in a disguise cloak, called out to you)[] Ready? Then let's move out. A royal guard loyal to me is waiting for us at the castle gates; he's one of those on duty tonight, so he can easily lead us to the part of the castle where Dariel is being held.
I dealt with the criminals and passed Princess Bernadette's test.
All right, thank you for agreeing to help me.
Damn, looks like I was a bit unlucky today.

[BLUE](and at the very bottom a puzzling note: "...writing it down so I don't forget: south passage - R-north, F-west, C,R-east; east passage - F-north, C-east, P-west, P-south; west passage - R,F-north, R-east, C-south)[]
A Holy Mission

What? Is she serious? I wanted to deal with this myself! Oh well, I know my sister well: you can't change her mind however hard you try. This forester lives in the village by the southern city wall, though he goes off into the forest for long stretches, so if you're lucky you'll catch him at home.
Adaon, get out of my sight before I kill you right here.
I see, I'll keep it in mind.

[BLUE](the sword came down on Captain Greedy's neck, and his severed head fell from the table and rolled across the floor)[] Well, that's done with. Lilia, clean up here, and tell the head of the guards to collect this traitor's head; its place is on the city wall.
Well, I'm courting a rich local lady here, and her requests are sometimes very particular. It was just while I was trying to fulfil one of her wishes that those freaks caught me.
Agnius Northson and I are looking for hunters to hire for a job. Perhaps you'll be interested.
These madmen tried to roast me and eat me; luckily this hero came to my rescue again.
Rrawr-rrrr.

[BLUE](The young, fragile-looking huntress you know)[] Hello, traveller. This is quite a cosy little place despite the frost. The local forests are full of all sorts of game. Want to go hunting with me?
Up north I came across the body of a sorceress. She carried a diary: she was trying to find a certain knight, to warn him of some danger and give him this cloak. Maybe you know who owns it?
I found and killed the huge bear; now I need to return to Baldwin and give him the beast's head.

Well, these ruins were once something like a teleportation beacon, and I sense it still works, despite its pitiful state. Just repeat after me the spell carved on the wall, then say the name of the one you're looking for.
